blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Not every perception error changes the planner's action. Yet adaptive-resolution perception chooses where to spend high-resolution computation from image cues, which can neither reliably point to an object that low resolution missed nor tell which objects matter to the planner. We observe that the planner can say where an object would matter before anything is seen: inserting a hypothetical object at a location tests whether its action would change. Decision-Guided Speculative Perception (DGSP) treats the low-resolution scene and its action as a draft and probes the planner in this way to obtain a decision-sensitivity field, the locations where an unseen object would change the action. Only this field and the support, the detections on which the current action rests, are verified at high resolution, repeatedly until the action is stable. For two planner classes, we prove that DGSP returns exactly the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception if crop detections match whole-frame ones and the crops cover the field, conditions that real images meet approximately. On three driving datasets, it reproduces this action on about 98% of frames with about a quarter of the pixels. At the pixel cost of uniform downscaling, it repairs more of the draft's disagreements with this action, brakes falsely less often, and recovers many more of the decision-relevant objects that the draft misses.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个感知错误都会改变规划者的行动. 然而适应分辨率感知选择从图像提示中花去高分辨率计算的地方,这既无法可靠地指向低分辨率缺失的对象,也无法说明哪些物体对规划者很重要. 我们观察到,规划者可以先说出物体在什么地方才重要:在一个位置上插入一个假设物体,测试它的动作是否会改变. 决策指导分光感知(DGSP)将低分辨率场景及其行动作为草案,并以这种方式对规划者进行探测,以获得决策敏感性场,即一个看不见的物体改变动作的地点. 只有这个领域和支持,即目前行动所依赖的探测,才能得到高分辨率的核查,直到行动稳定为止。 对于两个规划者类别,我们证明,DGSP返回的正是全帧高分辨率感知的动作,如果作物检测与全帧相匹配,而作物覆盖了田间,这些条件使真实的图像大致相会. 在3个驱动数据集上,它以大约四分之一像素在大约98%的帧上复制了这个动作. 以统一降级的像素成本,它修复了更多草案与这个动作的分歧,减低了错误的刹车次数,并回收了草案错过的更多与决定相关的物品.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Probing the planner shows where high resolution is needed. Schematic top view: a low-resolution draft detects a lead vehicle ( decelerate ) but misses a cut-in vehicle requiring hard-brake (dashed red; its location is given to no method).
(a) Detected-object refinement leaves it unseen.
(b) Whole-frame inference detects it at full-image cost.
(c) DGSP probes the planner with hypothetical objects and verifies the image regions of the field (orange) and support (blue), recovering hard-brake .
blocks.zh:
图1:调查规划人员显示需要高分辨率的地方。 外形上视图:低分辨率的草稿能检测出一款先导车(减速器),但错过了需要硬刹车(达克红色;其位置没有给出方法)的切入车.
(a) 被探测物体的精细化使其不为人知。
(b) 全帧推论以全图像成本检测出。
(c) DGSP用假想的物体对规划者进行探测并核实场(橙色)和支持(蓝色)的图像区域,恢复硬刹。

blocks.en:
An autonomous vehicle perceives its surroundings in order to act on them.
Megapixel cameras let it detect small and distant objects [ 3 , 44 ] , but running a detector on every frame at native resolution strains the compute budget of onboard hardware.
Adaptive-resolution methods therefore spend high resolution selectively: on image regions chosen by object priors [ 37 , 38 ] , learned saliency [ 30 , 42 ] , or coarse detections [ 9 , 19 ] , or on whole frames, by adapting the input scale [ 4 ] , the detector configuration [ 13 ] , or the choice of model [ 12 ] .
Their signals come from the image or the system state, not from the planner, which limits them in two ways.
They cannot reliably point to what low resolution failed to show: a missed object leaves no detection to refine, and locating it would require the very inference we try to avoid.
Nor do they know what matters: an object far from the vehicle’s path can receive as much computation as one forcing it to brake.
In Figure 1 (a), detected-object refinement sharpens the vehicles it already sees and leaves a nearer cut-in vehicle unseen, retaining decelerate where hard-brake is required; whole-frame inference in Figure 1 (b) removes this blind spot only at full cost.
blocks.zh:
自主车辆了解其周围环境以便采取行动。
Megapixel相机允许它探测出小型和遥远的物体[3,44],但按原生分辨率在每个帧上运行一个探测器会使机上硬件的计算预算紧张.
因此适应分辨率方法有选择地花高分辨度:在对象前作[37,38]所选择的图像区域上,通过调整输入尺度[4],探测器配置[13],或者选择型号[12]所学得的显著性[30,42],或者粗度探测[9,19],或者整个帧上.
他们的信号来自图像或系统状态,而不是来自规划者,这在两个方面限制了他们.
他们不能可靠地指出低分辨率未能显示的是什么:一个被忽略的物体没有被检测到可以完善,而定位它需要我们试图避免的推断。
他们也不知道什么是最重要的:一个远离车辆路径的物体可以像一个迫使车辆刹车的物体一样得到同样的计算。
在图1(a)中,被探测到的物体精细度使其已经看到的车辆更尖锐并留下了不见踪影的更接近被切入的车辆,在需要硬刹的地方保持减速;在图1(b)中,全帧推论仅以全额成本去除这一盲点。

blocks.en:
A human driver resolves this differently.
Before changing lanes, a driver checks the blind spot, not because a car is likely to be there, but because a car there would change what the driver does; when driving straight ahead, the same spot goes unchecked.
The intended action thus decides where to look, before anything is seen.
Our key observation is that a planner can make this decision explicitly: whether an object at a given location would change the action is a question about the planner, not about the image, and the planner can answer it for a hypothetical object placed there.
The choice of where to perceive thereby moves from the image to the planner, and an unseen object need not be found in order to know where it would matter.
blocks.zh:
人类的驱动力能以不同的方式解决这个问题。
在换车道之前,司机检查盲点,不是因为一辆车可能在那里,而是因为一辆车会改变司机的工作;当直行前行时,同一个盲点会不受控制.
因此,在看到任何东西之前,打算采取的行动决定了应往何处看。
我们的关键观察是,计划者可以明确做出这个决定:某个特定地点的物体是否会改变动作是一个关于计划者的问题,而不是图像的问题,计划者可以回答放置在那里的假设物体.
选择从何去何从,从图像转移到规划者,不需要找到一个看不见的物体才能知道它在哪里。

blocks.en:
We turn this insight into D ecision- G uided S peculative P erception (DGSP), which treats the scene and action of low-resolution perception as a draft and verifies only what could overturn that action.
Probing the planner with hypothetical objects yields a decision-sensitivity field , the locations where an unseen object would change the action (orange in Figure 1 (c)); it covers the cut-in vehicle although the draft never detected it.
Because the draft can also be wrong about what it does show, DGSP additionally identifies a support , the detections on which the current action rests (blue).
Only these regions are processed at high resolution, and the check repeats until the action is stable.
blocks.zh:
我们把这个洞察力转化为D精密-G uided S 精密的P受体(DGSP),它把低分辨率感知的场景和行动当作一个草案,并且只验证能够推翻这一行动的东西.
用假想物体对规划者进行试验会产生一个决策敏感性字段,即一个看不见的物体改变动作的位置(图1(c)中的橙色);它覆盖被切入的飞行器,尽管草稿从未探测到它。
因为草案对于它所显示的内容也可能是错误的,所以DGSP还额外确定了一个支持,即当前动作所依赖的检测(蓝色).
只有这些区域以高分辨率处理,检查会重复到动作稳定为止.

blocks.en:
Deriving the regions from the planner also changes what can be guaranteed: the target is no longer detection accuracy, but the reference action that whole-frame high-resolution perception would produce, and we prove that, under explicit conditions, DGSP returns exactly this action for certain braking controllers and fixed-trajectory planners.
Experiments on nuScenes [ 3 ] , Argoverse 2 [ 44 ] , and Argoverse-HD [ 27 ] test this on real images: with a 960-pixel reference, DGSP matches its action on 97.5–98.7% of frames with 22–27% of its detector-input pixels (6–8% of the native frame).
The saving is not that of a lower resolution: at the pixel cost of uniform downscaling, DGSP repairs 7–9 points more of the draft’s disagreements with the reference and raises braking F1 by 6–7 points, an advantage that grows with the range the planner must cover.
blocks.zh:
从规划者那里衍生出的区域也改变了可以保证的东西:目标不再是检测的准确性,而是整个框架高分辨率感知产生的参考动作,我们证明,在明确的条件下,DGSP会将这个动作完全返回给某些制动控制器和固定导出规划者.
nuScenes上的实验 [3],Argoverse 2 [44],和Argoverse-HD [27]在真实图像上测试:使用960-像素参考,DGSP将其在97.5-98.7%帧上的行动与其22-27%的探测器-输入像素(6-8%的原生帧)相匹配.
节省的不是更低的分辨率:以统一降级的像素成本,DGSP修复7–9点会增加草案对引用的分歧,并将制动F1提高6–7分,这个优势随着规划者必须覆盖的范围而增长.

blocks.en: Contributions. Our contributions are as follows: • We propose to decide where to perceive by querying the planner, not the image: probing it with hypothetical objects yields, without detections, a decision-sensitivity field marking where unseen objects change the action. • We develop an iterative high-resolution verification algorithm that combines this field with a support set of detections sufficient to preserve the current action, and prove that, under explicit conditions, it returns exactly the reference action for certain braking controllers and fixed-trajectory planners. • On three datasets, DGSP reproduces the reference action at about a quarter of its pixels and applies to other planners, even a black-box one, and to closed-loop braking.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 - 我们的捐助如下: 我们建议通过询问计划者而不是图像来决定在哪里感知:用假设的物体进行探测,在没有探测的情况下,在看不见的物体改变动作的地方进行决定敏感性场标。 我们开发出一种迭代高分辨率验证算法,将这个领域与足以保存当前动作的一组辅助检测结合,并证明在明确的条件下,它准确返回某些制动控制器和固定导轨规划器的参考动作. 在3个数据集上,DGSP以大约1/4的像素复制了参考动作,并适用于其他规划者,甚至一个黑盒一,以及闭路制动.

blocks.en: We propose to decide where to perceive by querying the planner, not the image: probing it with hypothetical objects yields, without detections, a decision-sensitivity field marking where unseen objects change the action.
blocks.zh: 我们建议通过询问计划者而不是图像来决定在哪里感知:用假设的物体进行探测,在没有探测的情况下,在看不见的物体改变动作的地方,进行决定敏感性场标。

blocks.en: We develop an iterative high-resolution verification algorithm that combines this field with a support set of detections sufficient to preserve the current action, and prove that, under explicit conditions, it returns exactly the reference action for certain braking controllers and fixed-trajectory planners.
blocks.zh: 我们开发出一种迭代高分辨率验证算法,将这个领域与一套足以保存当前动作的辅助检测集结合起来,并证明在明确的条件下,它完全返回某些制动控制器和固定导出规划器的参考动作.

blocks.en: On three datasets, DGSP reproduces the reference action at about a quarter of its pixels and applies to other planners, even a black-box one, and to closed-loop braking.
blocks.zh: 在3个数据集上,DGSP以大约1/4的像素复制了参考动作,并适用于其他规划者,甚至一个黑盒一,以及闭路制动.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Spatially selective detection. These methods concentrate high-resolution computation on selected image locations.
They refine regions chosen by learned policies [ 9 , 41 ] , cluster proposals [ 46 ] , or coarse detections [ 19 ] , process high-resolution features sparsely at predicted object locations [ 45 , 30 ] , or magnify salient areas using object priors, previous detections, or learned offsets [ 37 , 38 , 42 ] ; SAHI [ 1 ] instead slices the image into overlapping tiles.
DGSP shares their premise that most pixels need no high resolution, but not their selection signal: visual and detection cues are absent where low resolution misses objects.
blocks.zh:
空间选择性探测. 这些方法将高分辨率计算集中在选定的图像位置上。
它们精炼了通过学到的政策[9,41]、分组建议[46]或粗细的探测[19]选择的区域,在预测的物体地点稀有地处理高分辨率特征[45,30],或利用物体前身放大显著区域,以前的探测,或学到的抵消[37,38,42];SAHI[1]而是将图像切成相重叠的瓷砖.
DGSP同意他们的前提,即大多数像素不需要高分辨度,而不需要他们的选择信号:当低分辨度缺失对象时,没有视觉和检测提示.

blocks.en:
Frame-level adaptive inference. These methods apply one setting to the whole frame at run time: its input resolution [ 4 ] , the detector configuration [ 13 ] , or the choice of model [ 12 ] ; recent work also adapts to runtime slack [ 33 ] or LiDAR scene complexity [ 24 ] .
They trade accuracy against cost per frame, not per decision-relevant region.
blocks.zh:
框架级适应推论. 这些方法在运行时将一个设置应用于整个帧:其输入分辨率[4],探测器配置[13],或选择型号[12];最近的工作也适应了运行时间松动[33]或LiDAR场景复杂性[24].
它们以每个框架而不是与决策有关的区域的费用来交易准确性。

blocks.en:
Decision relevance in driving. Planning-oriented models such as UniAD [ 18 ] and PlanT [ 36 ] organize scene representations around downstream planning, and planner-centric metrics [ 34 , 28 ] , decision-value analysis [ 16 ] , and reachability-based perception zones [ 39 , 40 ] evaluate perception offline by the decisions its errors affect.
DGSP applies this criterion at run time, to allocate computation, in the spirit of the value of information [ 17 ] .
Object-importance studies [ 10 , 26 ] identify agents that influence driving, and counterfactual importance [ 14 ] removes or perturbs objects in the scene; our support plays this role for detections, but removal cannot point to an undetected object, the case our field addresses.
Hypothetical objects have precedents: PKL [ 34 ] inserts false positives on a grid to map planner sensitivity offline, occlusion-aware planners place phantom agents where nothing is observed [ 20 , 32 ] , and a learned relevance model scores objects on a grid to guide sensing [ 31 ] ; DGSP asks the planner itself where to look.
blocks.zh:
与驾驶相关的决定。 诸如UniAD[18]和PlanT[36]等面向规划的模型围绕下游规划组织场景展示,以及以规划者为中心的度量标准[34,28],决策价值分析[16],以可达性为基础的感知区[39,40]通过其错误影响的决定来评价线下感知.
DGSP在运行时应用这个标准,按照信息值的精神分配计算 [17].
物体重要性研究[10,26] 识别影响驾驶的物剂,反事实重要性[14]去掉或扰动现场的物体;我们的支持在探测中起到这一作用,但清除不能指向一个未被探测到的物体,即我们现场地址的病例.
假想对象有先例:PKL [34] 在网格上插入假阳性来将规划者敏感度图出下线,被隔离-有意识规划者将幽灵剂放入没有观测到的 [20,32],一个已学习到的相关模型在网格上对对象进行分数来引导感知 [31];DGSP询问规划者自己在哪里寻找.

blocks.en:
Planner-guided computation. Closest to our work are systems in which planning objectives direct perception, an idea dating back to robot driving [ 35 ] .
AnA [ 5 ] directs perception to agents of interest that the system already tracks, QuAD [ 2 ] queries occupancy at locations relevant to candidate plans, VeteranAD [ 47 ] gathers scene information along anchored trajectories, PAD [ 43 ] learns spatial attention for planning, and DriveAgent-R1 [ 48 ] actively requests more visual evidence.
There, relevance follows tracked agents, candidate plans, or learned attention. DGSP defines it counterfactually, as the object states whose insertion would change the current action, adds the detections sustaining it, and targets a reference, the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception, which it provably reproduces under explicit conditions, like speculative decoding [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh:
规划师指导的计算。 与我们的工作最接近的是计划目标直接感知的系统,这个想法可以追溯到机器人驾驶[35].
AnA [5] 将感想引导给感兴趣的代理商,认为系统已经跟踪, QuAD [2] 询问与候选人计划相关的地点的占用情况, VeteranAD [47] 沿着固定轨道收集场景信息, PAD [43] 学习空间注意力用于规划, DriveAgent-R1 [48] 积极要求更多的视觉证据.
在这方面,相关性是跟踪特工、候选人计划或获得注意。 DGSP实际上将其定义为:其插入会改变当前动作的物体表示,会增加维持它的探测,并针对一个参考,即整个框架高分辨率感知的动作,它在明确的条件下可以证明复制,如投机解码[25].

blocks.en: 3 Decision-Guided Speculative Perception
blocks.zh: 3 指导性的投机观念

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of DGSP on a nuScenes frame. (1) The cheap detector finds a truck and a pedestrian; the truck demands decelerate and forms the support.
(2) Probing the planner with hypothetical objects (“?”) gives the field (orange): at this ego speed, empty at decelerate and a short corridor at keep .
(3) The reference detector runs on the requested crops only: first the support crop, where the truck closes more slowly than the draft estimated, so the action drops to keep ; then the field footprint that keep opens (guard crops not shown).
(4) No new crop is requested; the planner returns the required keep . Figure 4 (a) shows the field recovering a missed object.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题表述

blocks.en:
Scenes differing in many detections can share an action, whereas one missed object can change it.
We therefore aim for decision fidelity : reproducing the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception with less detector computation.
blocks.zh:
许多检测中不同的场景可以共享一个动作,而一个被忽略的对象可以改变它.
因此,我们的目标是决定诚实:用较少的探测器计算来复制整个框架的高分辨率感知。

blocks.en:

A detected object o o has an image box and a state 𝐱 ⁡ ( o ) \mathbf{x}(o) —its range, lateral extent, and time to collision in the ego frame—which a lift estimates from the box, the calibration, and earlier frames.
A scene 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is a finite set of objects.
A planner π \pi is any deterministic downstream decision rule that maps the object states of a scene to an action for the fixed ego state, from a braking controller to a selector over fixed trajectories; our guarantees cover specific classes only.

blocks.en:
Sensitivity field. Rather than predicting where an unseen object may be, DGSP asks where one would change the action.
A probe o 𝐱 o_{\mathbf{x}} is a hypothetical object with state 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , and the decision-sensitivity field of a scene 𝒮 \mathcal{S} holds the states whose insertion changes the action: 𝒵 ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) = { 𝐱 : π ⁡ ( 𝒮 ∪ { o 𝐱 } ) ≠ π ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) } . \mathcal{Z}(\mathcal{S})\;=\;\{\,\mathbf{x}\,:\,\pi(\mathcal{S}\cup\{o_{\mathbf{x}}\})\neq\pi(\mathcal{S})\,\}. (2) The field measures action sensitivity, not object likelihood, and needs no image evidence, so it exists even where the draft detects nothing.
In practice, it is evaluated on a finite ground-plane grid of ranges and lateral offsets with a fixed-size probe that closes at a fixed speed, which can miss sensitive states.
Some planners need no explicit calls: for a braking controller, a probe is sensitive when its demand reaches the threshold of the next stronger action.

blocks.en:
Verifying a region can change the action, and with it the field and the support, so regions selected from the draft alone may not suffice: e.g . , removing a spurious hard-brake detection lowers the action, and a previously empty field requests a new region. Algorithm 1 therefore iterates from the draft ( Figure 2 ): it requests the field footprint and the support crops of the current merged scene and runs the reference detector only on those not yet inside ℛ \mathcal{R} , reusing earlier detections.
It stops when every requested crop lies inside ℛ \mathcal{R} .
Every non-final round adds pixels to ℛ \mathcal{R} , so the loop terminates; the experiments cap it at three rounds, which cuts off no braking test frame (Appendix C ).

The support holds the objects that keep some competing candidate at or below the selected score, such as an obstacle that blocks only an alternative trajectory.
Scores compose by the minimum, which gives insertion stability, and field and support need per-candidate scores but no re-planning.

支持将一些竞争对手保持在或低于所选分数的物体,例如只阻断可选轨迹的障碍.
分数由最低分数构成,这给予插入稳定性,外地和支助需要每个候选人的分数,但没有重新规划。

blocks.en: 3.4 Practical considerations
blocks.zh: 3.4 实际考虑

blocks.en:
Approximating the reference. Three mechanisms improve locality (Appendix B ). Grid-aligned crops are cut from the reference’s resized input on the detector’s stride grid, so the detector sees the same pixels in a crop as in the whole frame.
The truncation guard re-detects, in an enlarged crop, a box cut by an interior crop boundary, unless its demand is zero however the box is completed. Same-scale history estimates closing rates with a learned looming estimate from observations at one scale; the first round re-requests the previous support crops, and an object newly verified near the path is also re-detected in the previous frame.
blocks.zh:
约取所引. 三种机制改善了地方(附录B)。 网格相通的收成被从参考器在探测器的出行速度网格上所调整大小的输入中剪去,因此探测器在一收成中看到的像素与整个帧相同.
截取护卫重新探测,在被扩大的作物中,由内部作物边界切割出一个盒子,除非它的需求量是零,但盒子已经完成. 同尺度历史对收尾率进行估计,从一个尺度的观测中得出一个学习到的即将到来的估计;第一轮重新要求以前的支持作物,在路径附近新核实的物体也在上个帧中被重新发现.

blocks.en:
Lift. The lift estimates states by monocular geometry and the looming estimate and, once the loop has stopped, corrects the range of the verified support objects with a learned range refiner .
The reference uses the same lift; Theorem 1 covers the loop, not this final correction.
blocks.zh:
举起 升力估计通过单相位几何和即将到来的估计来表示,一旦循环停止,用有学识的测距精炼器来校正已核实的支持对象的范围.
参考使用相同的升力;定理1覆盖了回转,而不是这个最终的校正.

blocks.en: General planners. Without closed forms, probes and removals approximate the field and a support of pivots, which need not be certifying: DGSP still applies, at the cost of planner calls, but outside Theorem 1 ( Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 总计划者. 没有封闭的表格,探测器和去除器大致可以到达现场和得到小孔的支持,这些小孔不需要证明: DGSP仍然适用,成本为计划员呼叫,但在定理1之外(第4.4节.

blocks.en:
Planner and metrics. The planner is the braking controller of [ 16 ] , which is max-composable: the largest deceleration needed to stop short of an object in the ego corridor ( ± \pm 1.2 m, up to 80 m) selects keep , decelerate ( ≥ \geq{} 1.0 m/s 2 ), or hard-brake ( ≥ \geq{} 3.5 m/s 2 ). Decision fidelity , the primary target, is the agreement of the action with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) , and the repair rate is this agreement on the frames where the draft differs from π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) ; both score a whole pipeline, lift included.
Since π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) can itself be wrong, decision quality scores the actions against the annotations by braking episode: a maximal run of frames that require braking is missed if a pipeline never brakes in it, and a braking run with no required braking is false .
We report episode precision, recall, and F1.
Cost is measured in detector-input pixels (“pixels”): all pixels fed to a detector in a frame, draft and truncation guard included, in % of the native frame; the detector’s FLOPs are proportional to them (total FLOPs: Table 2 and Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
计划与度量衡. 规划者是 [16] 的制动控制器,该控制器最大可构成: 需要最大减速才能在自负走廊中停止一个物体(±\pm 1.2 m,可达80 m) 选择保持,减速(\\ geq{} 1.0 m/s 2 ),或硬刹 (\\ geq{} 3.5 m/s 2 ). 决定忠诚是首要目标,是行动与\\\ (F)\pi(\mathcal{F})的协议,修理率是这个关于草案与\\ (F)\pi(\mathcal{F}不同的框架的协议;两者都得分整个管道,包括升力.
由于QQ (F)\pi (\ mathcal{F}) 本身可能是错误的, 决策质量通过制动插曲来比对说明来评分动作: 如果管道内没有刹车, 需要制动的最大帧运行会被错过, 而不需要制动的制动运行是虚假的 。

blocks.en:
Datasets and protocol. We use the front cameras of nuScenes [ 3 ] (228 held-out scenes of its trainval set, not the official test split), Argoverse 2 [ 44 ] (val, 150 logs; the ego hood is masked for every pipeline), and Argoverse-HD [ 27 ] (val, 24 sequences).
One configuration is selected on development data of nuScenes and Argoverse 2, frozen before test evaluation, and applied to Argoverse-HD without tuning (Appendix B.3 ).
We test differences with 95% paired bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples over scenes, logs, or sequences), not adjusted for multiple comparisons unless stated; non-significance is not equivalence.
blocks.zh:
数据集与协议. 我们使用nuScenes [3] (228被搁置的列车场景,而不是官方的测试分出),Argoverse 2 [44] (Val, 150 log;每个管道的自负罩被遮住),以及Argoverse-HD [27] (val, 24个序列)的前相机.
在nuScenes和Argoverse 2的开发数据上选择了一个配置,在测试评价前被冷冻,并应用到Argoverse-HD上而无需调音(Appendix B.3 .

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare whole-frame inference at a long side of N N pixels (u N N ) and frame-, region-, and object-level methods, built on official code where possible, all with the same draft, lift, and unmodified detector, our crops and guard if they crop, and a setting tuned on development data over a grid that includes the published one (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了N像素(u N N)和帧、区域及对象级方法的长边的全帧推论,这些方法尽可能建立在官方代码之上,所有方法都使用同样的草稿、起重和未经修改的探测器,我们的作物和守卫,如果它们收割的话,并用包括已公布的(附录B)的网格来调整开发数据。

blocks.en:
Implementation. The cheap and reference detectors are the same COCO-pretrained [ 29 ] YOLOv8s [ 23 ] , applied to the frame at a long side of 320 pixels and to crops at the scale of the frame resized to a long side of 960 pixels, the verification resolution.
All pipelines but the draft share the lift of Section 3.4 (the monocular geometry of [ 16 ] , the learned looming estimate, and the range refiner), which DGSP applies to the objects it verifies.
The reference ℱ \mathcal{F} is whole-frame inference at the verification resolution (u960); native resolution is a separate baseline. u320 is the draft, and u320 + adds the learned parts at the same pixels.
Only DGSP uses the field, with a vehicle-sized probe on a ground grid (both varied in Appendix D.7 ), a margin that counts a cell as sensitive from 60% of the next threshold (a larger region, which Theorem 1 permits), and a cap of three rounds.
blocks.zh:
执行。 廉价和参考探测器是同一种COCO预制 [29] YOLOv8s [23],被应用到长边320像素的相框上,并被应用到相框大小调整到长边960像素的农作物上,即可验证分辨率.
除草稿外,所有管道都分担3.4节的升力([16]的单相几何、所学的接近估计和测距精炼器),DGSP适用于它核查的物体。
参考文献F\mathcal{F}是核查决议(u960);本地决议是一个独立的基线。 u320为草稿,而u320+在同一像素上添加所学习到的部分.
只有DGSP使用球场,在地面网格上有一个车辆大小的探测器(两者在附录D.7中都有不同),从下一个阈值的60%(一个更大的区域,定理1允许)算出一个单元格的敏感度,并有一个三发的上限.

blocks.en: DGSP reproduces the reference action at a fraction of its pixels. It agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 97.5–98.7% of frames—shifted by one pixel, the reference itself reaches only 98.7–99.2%—with 22–27% of the pixels and 23–36% of the FLOPs of the reference, lift included, and repairs 87–92% of the draft’s disagreements ( Tables 1 and 2 ). The shared lift alone repairs 60–70% (u320 + ), and relative to u320 + , DGSP has 64–71% fewer disagreements and u512 has 32–36% fewer. Each remaining disagreement traces to coverage (35–42%), locality (34–47%), or the refiner outside Theorem 1 (11–26%); idealizing locality and coverage raises the agreement to 99.7–99.9% (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: DGSP在其像素的一小部分复制了参考动作. 它同意在97.5-98.7%的相框由一像素转接时,参考本身只达到98.7-99.2-,22-27%的相像素和23-36%的参考FLOP, 升力包括,修理87-92%的草案分歧(表1和表2)。 共享升降机单机修复60–70%(u320 +),而相对于u320 +,DGSP的分歧减少64–71%,u512的争议减少32–36%. 其余的分歧都追溯到覆盖范围(35-42%)、地点(34-47%)或定理1以外的精炼器(11-26%);理想化的地方和覆盖范围将协议提高到99.7-99.9%(附录C)。

blocks.en:
It is more faithful than uniform inference with more pixels. u512, the next uniform resolution above the pixels of DGSP (and 1.3–1.6 × \times its FLOPs), repairs 7.3–9.4 points fewer and agrees on 1.1–3.0 points fewer frames, all significant after Holm correction (Appendix B ).
Most frames require no braking; on the 10–24% that do, the gap widens to 5–9 points (95–96% against 88–91%).
On the hardest frames, where π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) changes, DGSP still agrees on 84%, 83%, and 68%, against 77%, 75%, and 54% for u512.
The result holds with a second detector (YOLO11s), one fine-tuned on driving data, a native-resolution reference, or a geometric lift (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
它比像素比统一推断更忠实 u512,DGSP像素上方的下个统一解析度(并1.3-1.6 ×\times its FLOPs),修复后减少7.3-9.4分并商定减少1.1-3.0分帧,均在霍尔姆修正后(附录B.
大多数框架不需要制动;在10–24 % 的制动中,差距会扩大至5–9分(95–96 %对88–91 % ) 。
在最难的帧上,在 QQ (F)\pi (\ mathcal{F}) 变化中,DGSP仍然同意84%,83%,68%,而u512为77%,75%,54%.
其结果有第二个探测器(YOLO11s),一个对驱动数据进行微调,一个本土分辨率参考,或者一个几何升力(附录C.

blocks.en:
The advantage is largest where the draft is blind. On frames where the draft misses the decisive object ( Table 3 ), the advantage over u512 is 13–17 points, about three times that where the draft contains it, and even u640, with 1.7–2 × \times DGSP’s pixels, trails by 6–9 points: no detection marks the object, so verification reaches it through the field.
The advantage also grows with the range the planner must cover: the gap is within a point at low ego speed and grows with the range of the decisive object, from 2–4 points below 20 m to 8–13 points at 40–60 m. With the planner’s ego speed doubled and its range limit lifted, the overall gap widens from 1–3 to 5–10 points; for the smallest decisive objects, the repair gap is 16–28 points (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
在草案失明的情况下,优势最大。 在草稿错过了决定性对象的帧(表3)上,相对于u512的优势是13–17分,大约是草稿所含的三倍,甚至为u640分,有1.7–2×\times DGSP像素,有6–9分的痕迹:没有检测到物体的分数,所以校验通过现场到达它.
优势也随着计划者必须覆盖的范围而扩大:差距在低自负速度的一分之内,随着决定性物体的范围而扩大,从20米以下的2–4分到40-60米的8–13分. 随着计划者的自负速度翻了一番并解除了射程限制,总体差距从1–3到5–10分不等;对于最小的决定性物体,修理缺口为16–28分(附录C ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Decision quality versus pixel cost
blocks.zh: 4.3 决定质量与像素成本

blocks.en:
DGSP matches the reference’s F1 at higher precision with about a quarter of its pixels. Against the annotations, it has the highest F1 and precision on every dataset ( Table 2 and Figure 3 ).
Its F1 exceeds the reference’s by 4.0, 1.6, and 5.8 points (significantly on nuScenes) and u512’s by 6.2–6.9 points (all significant before correction; Appendix B ).
Its mean F1 is significantly above that of every method except native-resolution inference.
blocks.zh:
DGSP更精确地将参考文献的F1与其像素的约四分之一相匹配. 对照说明,每个数据集的F1和精确度最高(表2和图3)。
它的F1比参考数多出4.0分,1.6分,5.8分(在nuScees上显著)和u512分(在修正前均为重要;附录B)多出6.2-6.9分。
它的平均值F1明显高于除本土解析推论以外的每一种方法.

blocks.en:
The gain is in precision, with a recall trade-off against the reference. Where DGSP departs from π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) , it mostly drops braking that the scene does not require: it brakes less in 77–81% of these frames, and the annotations side with it in 61–72% and with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) in only 21–33%.
It is significantly more precise than u512 and the reference on every dataset. Restricted to the crops of DGSP, the reference becomes nearly as precise on nuScenes and Argoverse 2: there, the planner’s choice of regions explains most of the gain.
In exchange, the reference has 2.0–4.2 points higher recall (significantly on Argoverse 2); u512 does not differ significantly. With thresholds selected per pipeline on development data, DGSP misses 38, 25, and 17 episodes and the reference 45, 24, and 20, with no significant difference in false braking.
On 65 held-out Argoverse-HD sequences, DGSP’s F1 is significantly above that of u512 and the reference (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
收益是准确的,与参考书相比,有回溯权衡. DGSP偏离了 \\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 的地方,它大多会降低对场景不需要的刹车: 它在77–81%的这些帧中刹车较少,而注释部分则在 61–72% 和 \ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 在 21–33% 中。
它比u512和每个数据集的参考要精确得多。 除了DGSP的收成,NuScens和Argoverse 2:这里,规划者对区域的选择解释了大部分收益。
作为交换,参考值为2.0-4.2分高召回(在Argoverse 2上显著);u512没有显著差异. 由于每个管道在开发数据上选择了阈值,DGSP错过了38,25和17集,以及参考文献45,24和20,在错误制动上没有显著区别.

blocks.en:
Each mechanism addresses a distinct failure ( Table 4 ). Without the field, which reaches the objects that the draft lacks, the repair rate falls by 5–11 points and the recall by 6–14 points (all significant; Appendix D ).
Without the support, which verifies the detections on which the action rests, only 39–44% of the disagreements are repaired, and pivots in its place significantly lower the repair rate on all three datasets and the F1 on two.
The truncation guard significantly improves both metrics, and a second round raises the F1 on nuScenes and the held-out sequences (Appendix C ).
The range refiner, outside the guarantee, raises the F1 by 2.5–6.0 points; its repair-rate gain is measured against a reference that also uses it.
blocks.zh:
每一种机制都针对明显的失败(表4)。 没有达到草稿所缺少的物体的字段,修理率会下降5-11分,召回率会下降6-14分(都很重要;附录D)。
没有能够验证行动所依赖的检测结果的支持,只有39–44 %的分歧得到修复,而占位置的平地则大大降低了所有三个数据集和F1对两个数据集的修复率。
短跑后卫显著地改进了两个度量衡,第二轮则在nuScenes和被扣取序列上提升了F1(Appendix C.
范围精炼器在担保之外将F1提升了2.5–6.0分;其修补率增益根据同样使用它的参考物来测量.

blocks.en:
Probing reaches objects that the draft never detected ( Figures 4 and 5 ). Of the decision-relevant objects (annotated objects that alone require braking) that the draft misses, DGSP finds 41%, 51%, and 75%, including 85–97% of those the reference detects: 1.6–2 × \times as many as the support alone and significantly more than u512 (with more pixels), AnA, and CF.
With all relevant draft detections deleted, it still finds 93–97%, against 21–26% for AnA and CF. The same crops placed at random repair only 20–29% and recover 8–18%; crops around the annotated relevant objects recover about as many as DGSP but agree on only 88–95%, as they leave spurious detections unverified . Uncertainty crops with DGSP’s crop pixels repair less than u512. Of pedestrians and cyclists, DGSP finds 24–45%, against 0–21% for u512 (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
探测到达草稿从未探测到的物体(图4和图5)。 在草案漏掉的与决定有关的物体(仅说明需要制动的物体)中,DGSP发现41%,51%,75%,包括85-97%的参考检测: 1.6–2 ×\times as the support alone并显著地超过u512(有较多像素),AnA,和CF.
随着所有相关检测草案被删除,它仍然发现93-97%,而AnA和CF为21-26%。 随机修理的作物只有20-29%,回收了8-18 %;附加说明的相关物体周围的作物恢复了约88-95 %,因为它们留下了虚假的检测结果未经核实。 DGSP的作物像素修补不足u512的不确定作物. 在行人和骑自行车者中,DGSP发现24–45%,而u512为0–21%(附录D).

blocks.en:
Field and support follow from the planner ( Table 5 ). We apply DGSP to a braking controller on a curved path and to a bottleneck selector over 15 fixed trajectories on NAVSIM navtest [ 7 ] , each with its own field and certifying support.
On the curved path, the planner’s own regions reproduce its reference action significantly more often than u512 (at 0.75–0.89 × \times its pixels) and than the braking regions, whose F1 they raise by 4–12 points to the reference’s level (n.s.).
Under a time-to-collision warning, they are no more faithful than u512, and less so on Argoverse-HD (Appendix D ).
On the selector ( Corollary 2 ), DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 97.8% of the 12,146 scenes, against 94.0% for the draft and 95.9% at native resolution.
PDM-Closed [ 6 ] , outside the guarantee, is probed as a black box: DGSP selects a trajectory within 0.5 m of the reference’s on 97.2% of these scenes (91.2% for the draft). On both planners, it uses two thirds of the reference’s pixels (Appendix A.7 ).

blocks.en: 4.5 Closed-loop braking
blocks.zh: 4.5 闭路制动

blocks.en:
We run a controlled closed loop in CARLA [ 8 ] on the 155 braking routes of Bench2Drive [ 21 ] : a route follower steers, and the braking controller acts on each pipeline’s estimated scene, without the learned parts of the lift (Appendix E ).
DGSP has significantly fewer unnecessary hard-braking onsets than u320, u512, and the reference ( Table 6 ) and misses the fewest episodes, significantly fewer than u320 and u512; its preventable collisions are the fewest.
blocks.zh:
我们在CARLA运行一个可控闭路圈 [8] 在155 Braking roads of Bench2Drive [21]: a 路线后继器,而制动控制器则在每条管道的估计场景上进行操作,没有电梯的学习部分(附录E)。
与u320、u512和参考文献(表6)相比,DGSP的不必要的硬起发次数要少得多,并错过了最少的发作次数,大大少于u320和u512;其可预防的相撞次数最少。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
An image cannot show what it failed to resolve, so DGSP asks the planner where an unseen object would change the action and verifies these places together with the support of the action; under explicit conditions, this provably returns the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception.
On three driving datasets, it reproduces this action on 97.5–98.7% of frames with 22–27% of its detector-input pixels, has the highest braking F1, and leads uniform downscaling most where the draft misses the decisive object, by 13–17 points over u512.
Because verification runs on crops, it meets these conditions only approximately, and its temporal estimate needs a history at one scale, which crops provide for fewer objects than whole frames do, most visibly under a time-to-collision warning; DGSP also trades some recall for precision.
Because the regions follow the planner, the saving grows with how concentrated the planner’s sensitivity is: the braking field is a short corridor ahead of the vehicle.
The guarantee covers max-composable and bottleneck planners; general planners over object lists can be probed but lie outside it, and our single-camera results characterize decision quality and controlled braking, not driving safety.
Within this scope, a planner that can be queried about unseen objects turns its decision rule into a specification of what perception must verify.
blocks.zh:
一个图像无法显示它未能解决什么问题,因此DGSP询问规划者,一个看不见的物体会在哪里改变动作并验证这些位置,同时得到动作的支持;在明确的条件下,这可以证明会返回整个框架高分辨率感知的动作.
在三个驱动数据集上,它以97.5-98.7%的帧以22-27%的探测器-输入像素复制了这个动作,有最高的制动F1,在草稿错过了决定性对象的地方导致统一下调,比u512多了13-17分.
由于核查是在作物上进行的,因此仅大致满足这些条件,其时间估计需要有一个规模的历史,作物提供的物体比整个框架的要少,最明显的是在时间到曲线的警告下;DGSP还用一些记忆来换取精确度。
由于各地区都跟随规划者,因此储蓄随着规划者的灵敏度的集中而增长:刹车场是车前的一条短走廊.
保证范围包括最大可构成和瓶颈的规划者;一般规划者在对象清单之上可以被探测,但位于清单之外,我们的单相机结果是决定质量和控制制动的特点,而不是驱动安全。
在这一范围内,一个可以被问及隐形物体的策划者将它的决定规则变为一个说明,说明什么感觉必须加以核实。

blocks.en:
Locality is used in Step 1 to identify the verified objects with ℱ | ℛ \mathcal{F}|_{\mathcal{R}} , coverage in Step 2, certification in Step 3, and insertion stability in Step 4.
Certification is needed because the merged scene contains unverified draft objects, which may be spurious or mislocalized; insertion stability is needed because ℱ ¯ \bar{\mathcal{F}} may contain arbitrarily many objects that the procedure never observes.
Coverage is a condition on the reference scene, not on the probe grid: a finite grid satisfies it if every reference object whose state lies in the field has its box center in the verified region, and Sec. D.3 measures how often this holds for the decisive object. The proof uses the footprint only through coverage: the footprint is the means of reaching it.

A.5 Termination
blocks.zh: A.5 终止合同

blocks.en:
Each round that does not stop adds at least one crop that does not lie inside the union of the previous crops. The union therefore grows strictly, by at least one image pixel, and the loop stops after finitely many rounds; this argument needs neither locality nor a bound on the number of rounds.
Under locality, the requested crops are moreover drawn from a small finite set, namely the footprints of subsets of the finite ground grid and the crops of the finitely many objects of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and ℱ \mathcal{F} .
The experiments cap the loop at three rounds, and a frame that reaches the cap returns the action of its last merged scene; Theorem 1 covers only frames on which the loop reaches its stopping condition.
The implemented stopping test approximates containment: a requested crop counts as verified once at least 95 % 95\% of its area lies inside one earlier crop, and for a support crop, the guard crops also count. A rectangle with more than half of its area inside another rectangle has its center there, so that a support crop not clipped by the image boundary still has the box center of its object in that earlier crop; a footprint, however, can leave up to 5 % 5\% of its area unverified, which can affect coverage ( Tab. 8 ).

PDM-Closed [ 6 ] is not a bottleneck selector: its collision and time-to-collision terms are minima over objects, but they are combined multiplicatively and additively with other terms, and its candidate set depends on the objects.
Its field is obtained by probing the planner on the grid described below (a cell is sensitive if the planned 4 4 s trajectory moves by more than 0.5 0.5 m), and its support by removal queries, i.e . , as the set of pivots, which is not guaranteed to be certifying; we therefore measure violations of the certification condition Eq. 3 on 1,000 1{,}000 navtest frames: of 9,449 9{,}449 pairs of objects outside the support, 6 6 change the plan only when removed together ( 𝒟 \mathcal{D} of size two, 𝒪 = ∅ \mathcal{O}=\varnothing ), and of 139,675 139{,}675 combinations of a probe outside the field and the removal of an object outside the support, 11 11 do ( | 𝒟 | = | 𝒪 | = 1 |\mathcal{D}|=|\mathcal{O}|=1 ); adding the corresponding objects to the support changes the score of none of the 1,000 1{,}000 frames.

Empirical check of Corollary 2 . We instantiate a bottleneck selector on NAVSIM navtest with 15 15 candidates, namely the route centerline offset by 0 0 and ± 1.5 \pm 1.5 m combined with constant accelerations of + 2 +2 , + 1 +1 , 0 0 , − 1.5 -1.5 , and − 3 -3 m/s 2 ; the preference β \beta is 5 5 s times the normalized progress, and 𝗁 ⁡ ( c , o ) \mathsf{h}(c,o) is the time of the first overlap of the ego footprint along c c with object o o under constant velocity, capped at 5 5 s.
The field is probed with a static vehicle on a 7 × 7 7\times 7 ground grid ( 8 8 – 55 55 m ahead, ± 10.5 \pm 10.5 m laterally), and the support is the binding set of Lemma 2 .
With the whole-frame detections inside the crops, i.e . , with locality enforced, the procedure agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 99.71 % 99.71\% [ 99.58 , 99.83 ] [99.58,\allowbreak\,99.83] of the 12,146 12{,}146 scenes and on 95.2 % 95.2\% of the 724 724 scenes in which the cheap draft does not.
In each of the 35 35 remaining scenes, an object outside the crops changes the selection when it is inserted alone, i.e . , the finite grid of static probes misses a sensitive state; no disagreement is due to a joint effect.
With real crop detections, DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 97.83 % 97.83\% [ 97.38 , 98.22 ] [97.38,\allowbreak\,98.22] of the scenes and repairs 74.5 % 74.5\% of the 724 724 disagreements of the draft, with 17.7 % 17.7\% of the native pixels on average (median 13.4 % 13.4\% ), two thirds of the 26.7 % 26.7\% of the reference ( − 8.9 -8.9 points [ − 9.8 , − 8.0 ] [-9.8,\allowbreak\,-8.0] ).
The draft agrees on 94.04 % 94.04\% , whole-frame inference at 512 512 pixels on 94.08 % 94.08\% with 7.1 % 7.1\% of the pixels ( Tab. 5 ), and whole-frame inference at the native resolution on 95.92 % 95.92\% ; DGSP agrees 3.8 3.8 [ 3.2 , 4.5 ] [3.2,\allowbreak\,4.5] , 3.75 3.75 [ 3.11 , 4.46 ] [3.11,\allowbreak\,4.46] , and 1.9 1.9 [ 1.5 , 2.4 ] [1.5,\allowbreak\,2.4] points more often (paired bootstrap over the 136 136 logs).
The field of this selector spans all 15 15 candidates; its footprint is one crop per 8-connected cluster of sensitive cells ( 1.0 1.0 per scene on average), and each support crop is the object box enlarged 1.25 1.25 times about its center ( 3.1 3.1 per scene); the field crops take 6.1 % 6.1\% and the support crops 2.8 % 2.8\% of the native pixels, besides the draft and the re-detections of the truncation guard. Both choices keep the field and the certifying support of Corollary 2 , since every sensitive probe box and every support box lies inside a requested crop; a scene takes 1.5 1.5 rounds on average, and 0.45 % 0.45\% of the scenes reach the round cap.
For the braking controllers, one crop per cluster returns the single crop of DGSP on every frame of the three datasets, because their sensitive cells, a range interval within the ego corridor, always form one cluster. With the field and support of the straight-path braking controller instead of its own, DGSP agrees on 96.53 % 96.53\% [ 95.96 , 97.00 ] [95.96,\allowbreak\,97.00] of the scenes with 10.7 % 10.7\% of the pixels, 1.3 1.3 points [ 1.0 , 1.7 ] [1.0,\allowbreak\,1.7] below its own regions and 0.6 0.6 points [ 0.1 , 1.1 ] [0.1,\allowbreak\,1.1] above native whole-frame inference ( Tab. 5 ).
On 1,000 1{,}000 scenes, none of the 769,561 769{,}561 pairs of probes whose single insertions leave the selection unchanged changes it jointly, consistent with Lemma 1 ; this checks the implementation on the sampled pairs, whereas the guarantee itself follows from the lemma.

blocks.en: B.1 Planner and lift
blocks.zh: B.1 规划和电梯

blocks.en:
Braking controller. The planner of the experiments is the braking controller of [ 16 ] .
For an object within the ego corridor (half-width 1.2 1.2 m) and within 80 80 m, at range r r and with ego speed v v , the demand is 𝖽 = min ⁡ ( max ⁡ ( v 2 2 ​ ( r − r 0 − v ​ t r ) , v rel 2 2 ​ ( r − r 0 ) ) , 9 ) ​ m / s 2 , \mathsf{d}=\min\!\Big(\max\Big(\tfrac{v^{2}}{2\,(r-r_{0}-v\,t_{r})},\ \tfrac{v_{\mathrm{rel}}^{2}}{2\,(r-r_{0})}\Big),\ 9\Big)\ \mathrm{m/s^{2}}, (27) with stand-off distance r 0 = 2 r_{0}=2 m, reaction time t r = 0.4 t_{r}=0.4 s, and closing speed v rel = r / ttc v_{\mathrm{rel}}=r/\mathrm{ttc} , where the denominators are bounded from below by 0.1 0.1 m; objects outside the corridor have 𝖽 = 0 \mathsf{d}=0 .
The action is hard-brake if the largest demand is at least τ 2 = 3.5 ​ m / s 2 \tau_{2}=3.5\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}} , decelerate if it is at least τ 1 = 1.0 ​ m / s 2 \tau_{1}=1.0\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}} , and keep otherwise.
The controller is max-composable (Definition 1 ) with K = 2 K=2 .

Geometric lift. Each detection is lifted to an object state in the ego frame with a pinhole camera model, as in [ 16 ] .
The range combines a ground-plane cue, computed from the bottom edge of the box, and a height cue, computed from the box height and a class-specific height prior; the weight of the ground-plane cue increases with the distance of the contact point from the horizon.
The lateral extent follows from the horizontal box edges at the estimated range.
The draft (u320) uses this lift with a time-to-collision from the change of the box between two consecutive frames.
blocks.zh:
几何举. 每一次探测都解除在自负相框中的物体状态,有针孔相机模型,如[16].
范围结合了从箱底边缘计算出的一个地上飞机提示和从箱外高度和先前的分级高度计算出的一个地上飞机提示;地上飞机提示的权重随着接触点从地平线的距离而增加。
横向范围取自估计范围的水平框边缘。
草案(u320)使用这个起重机,从相接两个相框之间的相框变化时得到一个时间到缩合.

blocks.en:
Looming estimate. For every pipeline other than the draft, the time-to-collision comes from a learned looming estimate: a ResNet-18 [ 15 ] with shared weights is applied to the 64 × 64 64\times 64 crops of an object in the last three frames, and its features are combined with the box features, the ratios of consecutive box heights, and the frame interval to regress the relative closing rate, i.e . , the inverse time-to-collision.
All three observations must stem from detections at the same scale; an object with fewer observations carries no time-to-collision, and an object is assigned one only if the estimated rate exceeds a small threshold.
The estimate is trained on detections from Argoverse 2 training logs and nuScenes training scenes, with model selection on held-out logs and scenes of both.
blocks.zh:
低温估计。 对于草稿以外的每一个管线,时间到折叠来自一个已学习到的即时估计:一个有共享权重的ResNet-18 [15]被应用到后三帧中一个物体的64×64相64相64收的收成上,其特征与盒状特征,相接箱高之比,相接箱相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相

估计内容是从Argoverse 2培训日志和nuScens培训场景进行检测培训的,同时在搁置日志和两个场景上进行模型选择。

blocks.en:
Detector settings. Of the COCO classes, person, bicycle, motorcycle, car, bus, and truck are kept and mapped to person, cyclist (bicycle, motorcycle), and vehicle (car, bus, truck); a box takes its best class among the six, and all other classes are dropped before non-maximum suppression.
Every detector call, i.e . , the draft, whole frames, crops, and the re-detections of the truncation guard and of the same-scale history, keeps candidates with a class score above 0.10 0.10 , applies class-aware non-maximum suppression at an IoU of 0.65 0.65 with at most 100 100 boxes, and retains the detections with a confidence of at least 0.25 0.25 .
Detections are matched to annotations within compatible classes by Hungarian matching at an IoU of at least 0.3 0.3 .
blocks.zh:
探测器设置 。 在COCO班级中,个人、自行车、摩托车、汽车、公交车和卡车被保存并被绘制成个人、骑自行车(自行车、摩托车)和车辆(汽车、公交车、卡车);在非最大压制之前,一个箱子在6个班级中占据了最好的班级,所有其他班级都投放。
每一次探测器调用,即: 草稿,全帧,收成,以及分流后卫和同级历史的再探测,使分出分数高于0.100.10的考生保持分数,在0.65 0.65的IOU上适用有分数的非最大压制,最多100个箱子,并保留了有把握的至少0.25 0.25.
检测结果与相容类中的注解相匹配,用匈牙利语匹配的IoU至少为0.3 0.3.

blocks.en:
Association across frames. The time-to-collision of the draft associates each box greedily with a draft box of the previous frame at an IoU of at least 0.3 0.3 and equals Δ ​ t / ( h t / h t − 1 − 1 ) \Delta t/(h_{t}/h_{t-1}-1) for a box of height h h that grows, and infinity otherwise.
For the looming estimate, each pipeline keeps its own history of detections at one scale in the two previous frames (crop-verified detections for DGSP and the crop rules, whole-frame detections otherwise) and chains a detection to it by greedy association at an IoU of at least 0.3 0.3 ; an object without a chain keeps the geometric range and lateral extent and carries no time-to-collision.
The thresholds are the same for every pipeline.
blocks.zh:
跨边框的关联. 草稿的时间与缩合使每个盒子贪得无厌地在IoU上用上一个框架的草稿盒至少0.3分并等同于Δ t / (h t / h t − 1 − 1)\Delta t / (h_{t / h_{t 1} 1) 对于一个生长出高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高高
对于即将到来的估计,每条管线在前两个帧中将自己的探测历史维持在一个尺度上(对DGSP的作物验证检测和作物规则,全帧检测除外),并用至少0.3 0.3 的IoU的贪婪关联将探测器链起来;一个没有链子的物体保持了几何范围和横向范围,没有时间到曲线。
每个管道的阈值都是一样的。

blocks.en:
Range refiner. The refiner is a ResNet-18 that receives a 64 × 64 64\times 64 crop and box features and regresses a correction of the log-range.
It is applied once, after the loop has stopped, to the verified support objects of the final scene, and, for whole-frame pipelines including ℱ \mathcal{F} , to the support of their scene.
It is trained on detections from KITTI [ 11 ] train ( 14,605 14{,}605 ), nuScenes training scenes ( 62,527 62{,}527 ), and 340 340 Argoverse 2 training logs ( 96,918 96{,}918 ), with model selection on KITTI val and 60 60 further Argoverse 2 training logs.
No scene, log, or sequence of a development or test split, and no Argoverse-HD data, is used to train the looming estimate or the refiner.
blocks.zh:
范围精炼器. 精炼器为ResNet-18,接收了64×64相64的收割和盒状特征并递回了对日志范围的校正.
在循环停止后,它一次性被应用到最终场景的已核实的支持对象上,对于包括F\mathcal{F}在内的全帧管,则被应用到他们的场景的支持上.
它从KITTI[11]列车(14,605 14{,}605),nuScenes训练场景(62,527{,}527),和340340Argoverse 2训练日志(96,918 96{,}918)接受探测训练,模型选择在KITTI val上,还有60个Argoverse 2训练日志.
不使用场景、日志或开发或测试分解的顺序,也不使用Argoverse-HD数据来训练即将到来的估计或精炼器。

blocks.en: B.2 Field, support, and verification loop
blocks.zh: B.2 外地、支助和核查循环

blocks.en:
Field. The field is evaluated on a ground grid with the ranges { 12.5 , 17.5 , 22.5 , 27.5 , 35 , 45 , 55 , 70 } \{12.5,17.5,22.5,27.5,35,45,55,70\} m and lateral offsets from − 6 -6 to 6 6 m in steps of 1.5 1.5 m, with a vehicle-sized probe of 1.8 × 1.6 1.8\times 1.6 m that closes at v close = 3 v_{\mathrm{close}}=3 m/s, i.e . , with the time-to-collision r / v close r/v_{\mathrm{close}} in Eq. 27 ; for the braking controller on this grid, it selects the same cells as a static probe ( Tab. 34 ).
For the braking controller, the closed form of Corollary 1 applies: a cell is sensitive if the demand of the probe reaches the threshold of the next stronger action.
We use a margin and count a cell as sensitive from 60 % 60\% of that threshold; the current action is always that of the true thresholds.
The margin enlarges the field, and verifying a superset of the field preserves coverage.
The footprint is the rectangle that bounds the image boxes of the sensitive probes, aligned to the stride grid of the detector.
blocks.zh:
战地. 在地面网格上评价该场,范围为{12.5、17.5、22.5、27.5、35、45、55、70}{12.5、17.5、22.5、27.5、35、45、55、70} m和相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接
对于制动控制器来说,Corrollary 1的闭合形式适用:如果探测器的需求达到下一个更强动作的阈值,则细胞是敏感的.
我们用一个比值,从这个阈值的60%到60分,把一个单元格算作敏感;当前的动作总是真正的阈值。
差值可以扩大外地范围,核查一个超组外地范围可以保持覆盖面。
足迹是将敏感探测器的图像箱相接而成的矩形,与探测器的出行速度网格相接.

blocks.en:
Support. The support is that of Corollary 1 : every object whose demand reaches the threshold of the current action, and no object at keep .
Each support object contributes a crop of twice its box size around its center.
blocks.zh:
供养. 支持是 Corollary 1 : 每一个要求达到当前动作阈值的物体, 并且没有目标保持 。
每个支持对象在其中心周围贡献出一个其盒大小为两倍的收成.

blocks.en:
Grid-aligned crops. The reference detector processes the frame resized to a long side of 960 960 pixels and letterboxed.
Each crop window is cut from this input on the stride- 32 32 grid of the detector, without resizing, so that the detector sees in a crop the pixels that it sees in the whole frame, with image context instead of padding up to the window border.
blocks.zh:
网状相通的作物. 参考探测器处理帧被调整为960 960像素的长边并被收发信箱.
每个收割窗口都从这个输入中切入到检测器的脚步- 32 32 格格上,没有调整大小,这样检测器就会从一个收割器中看到它在整个帧中看到的像素,有图像上下文,而不是粘贴到窗口边框.

blocks.en:
Truncation guard. A crop detection whose box is cut by a crop border inside the image is re-detected in an enlarged crop (at most two enlargements, after which it is merged as it is), and it is dropped if no detection of the enlarged crop covers half of it.
The guard skips a truncated box whose demand is zero for every completion of the box, since it cannot change the action.
Guard crops count as pixels.
blocks.zh:
截取卫. 在扩大的作物中重新检测出其盒子被图像内的作物边界所切割的作物(在扩大后最多两次,然后按原样合并),如果不检测扩大的作物覆盖其中一半,则将其丢弃。
后卫跳过一个短盒,每完成一个盒子,其需求为零,因为它不能改变动作.
卫所收稼计为像素.

blocks.en:
Same-scale history. The looming estimate needs three observations of an object at one scale, which crops provide only if the object is verified in consecutive frames.
Two mechanisms keep this history.
The first round also requests the support crops that were verified in the previous frame.
An object that is newly verified in the ego corridor within 40 40 m and has no same-scale history is, in addition, detected in the same window (twice its box) of the stored reference input of the previous frame; these passes count as pixels. This supplies an observation from the previous frame next to the one from the current frame; the next frame supplies the third, so that the looming estimate starts one frame earlier than without the re-detection; the estimate is never computed from fewer than three observations.
blocks.zh:
同级历史. 即将到来的估计需要在一个尺度上对一个物体进行三次观察,只有在连续的帧中验证该物体时,作物才会提供这种观察.
两个机制保持了历史。
第一轮还请求在上个框架中核实的支持作物。
40米以内在自负走廊被新核实且没有同级历史的物体,除此之外,在上个帧所存储的参考输入的同一窗口(二分之一的框)中被检测出;这些传出被算作像素. 这提供了来自当前框架的上个框架旁边的观察;下个框架提供了第三个框架,从而使即将到来的估计比没有再探测的时间更早开始一个框架;这一估计从未从不到三个观察中计算出。

blocks.en:
Merging and stopping. A draft detection is replaced if its box center lies in a verified crop; of two detections from overlapping crops with an IoU of at least 0.5 0.5 , the more confident one is kept, and a draft detection with such an overlap to a kept detection is removed once guard crops were used.
The loop runs at most three rounds.
A requested crop counts as verified once at least 95 % 95\% of its area lies inside one earlier crop.
DGSP-fast is DGSP with a single round.
blocks.zh:
兼并而止. 如果箱子中心是经过核实的作物,则更换了检测草稿;如果用至少0.5分的IoU对重叠作物进行两次检测,则保存的检测草稿越有信心,一旦使用警卫作物,就会去除与被保存的检测草稿重叠的检测草稿。
循环运行时间最多为三轮.
要求的作物至少95%的95%的面积位于先前的作物内,但经核实后予以计算。
DGSP-快取是一发一发的DGSP.

条件(一)和(二)完全为实验的规划者持有,所以DGSP和QQ(F)\pi(\mathcal{F})在一个框上的所有分歧,其圈圈内停止来自局部,覆盖,或范围精炼器,在圈圈后作用而定理不覆盖.

blocks.en: B.3 Datasets and metrics
blocks.zh: B.3 数据集和计量标准

blocks.en: Table 9 : Datasets and splits. Episodes: braking episodes required by the annotations. The nuScenes development and test splits are disjoint sets of scenes of its trainval set (the latter is not the official test set) and are disjoint from the scenes used to train the learned parts of the lift.
blocks.zh: 表9:数据集和分数。 Episoides:由"说明"要求的制动集. nuScenes的开发与测试分拆是其列车系列(后者不是正式的测试集)的脱节场景集,与用来训练电梯所学到的部分的场景脱节.

blocks.en:
Datasets. Table 9 lists the splits.
The 300 300 Argoverse 2 development logs are training logs that are disjoint from the logs used to train the refiner and the looming estimate.
Argoverse-HD has no development split: it is evaluated with the configuration shared by all datasets.
The front camera of Argoverse 2 images the hood of the ego vehicle, which the COCO-pretrained detector reports as a vehicle in the ego corridor at low resolution; a fixed image band (rows ≥ 1830 \geq 1830 of 2048 2048 ) is therefore masked for every pipeline by discarding the detections whose box lies in the band by at least one half.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 表9列出了拆分情况。
300 300个Argoverse 2开发日志是培训日志,与用于培训炼油厂的日志和即将到来的估计数脱节。
Argoverse-HD没有开发分拆:它是用所有数据集共享的配置来评价的.
Argoverse 2的前相机画面为自负车的车头,COCO先行的探测器以低分辨率报告为自负走廊中的一辆车;因此,每条管线的固定图像波段(2048年的1830\geq 1830)被蒙上面具,丢弃了其盒装在波段的探测器至少一半.

blocks.en:
Selection of the configuration. The braking configuration of DGSP for the three camera datasets is selected only on the 152 152 nuScenes development scenes and the 300 300 Argoverse 2 development logs of Tab. 9 , which are disjoint from the units used to train the learned parts of the lift and from the test splits.
A component or parameter is adopted if the confidence interval of its effect is above zero on one development set and its point estimate is non-negative on the other; shared values are preferred to dataset-specific ones.
The selected configuration, its code, the weights of the looming estimate and the range refiner, and the decision criterion are frozen before evaluation on the three test splits.
Argoverse-HD is used neither for configuration selection nor for tuning: it receives the same configuration. Section B.2 specifies the resulting field, support, crops, guard, history, and stopping rule; the baseline settings are selected separately as described in Sec. B.4 .
blocks.zh:
选择配置. 三相相机数据集DGSP的制动配置仅在152个152个nuScenes开发场景和Tab的300个300个Argoverse 2开发日志上选择. 9,与用于训练升力所学部分的单位和从测试分出的部分脱节.
如果一个组件或参数的效果对一个开发集的置信间隔超过零,而其点估计对另一个开发集的取信间隔不负,则采用该组件或参数;共享值比数据集特定值优先.
所选配置,其代码,即时估计和测距精炼器的权重,以及决定标准被冻结后,再对三次测试分解进行评价.
Argoverse-HD既不用于配置选择,也不用于调音:它得到相同的配置. B.2节规定了由此产生的田地、支助、作物、警卫、历史和停止规则;基线设置按第B.4节所述另行选择。

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. Unless stated otherwise, results are reported on the test splits of Tab. 9 with the frozen configuration.
The test-split analyses use the final configuration; no configuration is changed on the basis of these analyses.
blocks.zh:
评估协议。 除非另有说明,结果将报告在Tab的测试分中。 9与被冻结的配置.
测试-分解分析使用最终配置;没有在这些分析的基础上改变配置.

blocks.en:
Fidelity. The agreement is the share of frames on which a pipeline takes the action π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) , and the repair rate is the agreement on the frames on which the draft takes another action.
We also report the agreement on the frames on which π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) changes from the preceding frame (Trans.).
All three are computed from the actions alone, and each pipeline keeps its own temporal history.
blocks.zh:
忠诚 协议是管道在哪些框架上采取行动 \\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) , 修复率是草案采取另外行动的框架协议 。
我们还报告关于π(F)\pi(\mathcal{F})从上一个框架(Trans.)中更改的架构的协议。
三者都是从行动中单独计算出来的,每一条管道都有自己的时间历史。

blocks.en:
Decision quality. The required action of a frame is the action of the controller on the annotated objects with their annotated states.
These states come from the 3D annotations of each dataset, not from image boxes or from the lift: the footprint of an annotated cuboid in the ego frame gives its range and lateral extent, and the change of its range along the annotated track gives its closing rate and time-to-collision.
Argoverse-HD itself provides image boxes only; its states are taken from the 3D track labels of the underlying Argoverse tracking logs ( 10 10 Hz), assigned to a camera frame from the LiDAR sweep closest in time (within 50 50 ms) and motion-compensated to the camera timestamp; the 56 56 of its 15,062 15{,}062 test frames without such a sweep are processed but not scored.
A required braking episode is a maximal run of frames whose required action is at least decelerate , with gaps of one frame merged; it is missed (FN) if the pipeline brakes in none of its frames, and it is a true positive (TP) otherwise.
A false episode (FP) is a maximal run of braking frames of the pipeline that contains no frame of a required episode.
Precision is TP / ( CLOSE /( TP + + FP ) ) , recall is TP / ( CLOSE /( TP + + FN ) ) , and F1 is 2 2 TP / ( 2 CLOSE /(2 TP + + FP + + FN ) ) .
The decisive object of a frame is the annotated object with the largest demand, and an annotated object is decision-relevant if its own demand reaches τ 1 \tau_{1} .
blocks.zh:
决定质量. 一个框架需要采取的行动是控制器对附加注释的物体及其附加注释的状态采取的行动。
这些状态来自每个数据集的3D注解,而不是从图像框或升起:自负框中被注解的立体的足迹给出了它的幅度和横向范围,而沿着被注解的轨迹对其范围的变化则给出了它的收尾率和时间到缩合.
Argoverse-HD本身仅提供图像盒;其状态取自基础Argoverse跟踪日志(10 10 Hz)的3D轨迹标签,被分配到LiDAR扫描最接近(50 ms以内)的相机帧上并被运动补偿到相机时间戳上;其15,062 15{,}062个没有这种扫描的测试帧中的56个56被处理而未得分.
需要的制动插曲是最大程度的帧运行,其所需的动作至少是减速的,有一个帧的缺口被合并;如果管道刹车在任何一帧中都没有出现,就会错过(FN),否则就是一个真正的正(TP).
假插曲(英語:FP)是管线的制动帧的最大运行,其中没有包含一个需要的插曲的帧.
精度为TP / (CLOSE / (TP + + FP)),召回为TP / (CLOSE / (TP + + FN)),F1为2 TP / (2 CLOSE / (2 TP + + + FP + FN)).
一个框架的决定性对象是需求最大的注解对象,一个注解对象如果自身的需要达到\\ tau\ 1} 则与决定相关.

blocks.en:
Pixels. The detector-input pixels of a frame are measured on the input tensors of the detector, padded to multiples of 32 32 pixels: the draft pass, every crop, and every re-detection of the truncation guard and of the same-scale history; native-resolution inference therefore exceeds 100 % 100\% .
For a baseline, they include the cheap pass if the method uses it, the mosaics of UFP, and the canvases of FOVEA.
The 64 × 64 64\times 64 inputs of the looming estimate and of the refiner are not counted as detector-input pixels in any pipeline.
blocks.zh:
如来相. 帧的探测器-输入像素在探测器的输入分数上被测量出,并被加到32个32像素的倍数上:通过草稿,每个收成,以及每次再检测出分叉后卫和同一比例的历史;因此,本地解析度推断超过100%100分.
就基线而言,它们包括使用这种方法的廉价通行证、UFP的镶嵌图和FOVEA的画布。
64×64 64\times 64输入即时估计和精炼器不计算为任何管道中的探测器-输入像素.

blocks.en:
Statistical comparisons. We use 2,000 2{,}000 paired bootstrap resamples of scenes, logs, or sequences, retaining the same sampled units for the pipelines being compared, and report 95 % 95\% percentile intervals.
The Mean columns of Tab. 2 weight the three datasets equally, and their intervals average the bootstrap replicates of the three datasets, each resampled over its own units.
A difference is significant when its interval excludes zero; † and ∗ indicate that the value of DGSP is significantly higher and lower, respectively, rather than better and worse irrespective of the metric.
Unless stated otherwise, comparisons are not adjusted for multiplicity, and a non-significant difference does not establish equivalence.
The resampling for the controlled closed loop is specified separately in Appendix E . Table 10 gives the intervals of the primary comparisons with u512 in agreement and repair rate; all remain significant after a Holm correction.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Table 11 : Baselines and their implementations. “Official”: the released code; “re-implementation”: our implementation of the published method; AnA, Chanakya: the selection rule of the cited work within our pipeline and with our planner, not a reproduction of the original system.

blocks.en:
Shared components. Every baseline runs the draft pass shared by all pipelines (YOLOv8s at a long side of 320 320 pixels, confidence threshold 0.25 0.25 ) if it uses one, and YOLOv8s at the scale or on the regions that the method selects.
In DGSP, a draft object that is not verified keeps the geometric lift of the draft (u320); the looming estimate and the refiner act on verified objects only.
Every baseline uses the lift of the reference: the geometric lift, the looming estimate on its own same-scale history, and the range refiner on the support of the braking controller in its own scene.
Methods that crop use the grid-aligned crops, the truncation guard, and the merge rule of DGSP.
The baselines therefore differ from DGSP and from one another in where the detector runs and in what follows from it, such as which objects have the same-scale history of the looming estimate; none is the original system as published.

blocks.en:
Region rules of the object-level baselines. AnA and counterfactual importance select regions from the detections of the draft with their own rule and use no region of DGSP.
The former re-detects every draft detection in the ego corridor within 80 80 m, as in [ 5 ] .
The latter re-detects the draft objects whose removal, or whose perturbation in range or time-to-collision, changes the action, as in [ 14 ] .
Neither searches where the draft detects nothing.

Selection. For each baseline, a predefined grid of settings, which includes its official or previously reported form, is scored on the development data, and the setting with the highest mean F1 over nuScenes and Argoverse 2 is evaluated once on the test splits; Tab. 11 lists the selected settings.
Argoverse-HD uses the baseline settings selected on Argoverse 2, without tuning on its sequences.
No learned component of any baseline uses a test unit.
On Argoverse 2, the scale classifier of AdaScale and the router estimators were fit on training logs that include 242 242 of the 300 300 development logs, which can make their selection optimistic.

blocks.en: Table 17 : Departures from the reference action (test splits). Dep.: frames on which the pipeline takes another action than π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) (%); Less: share of these frames on which it brakes less than π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) ; Row / ℱ \mathcal{F} : share on which the annotated scene requires the action of the pipeline / of π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) (%; the annotation can require neither).

Table 17 characterizes the frames on which a pipeline departs from π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) .
DGSP departs least often, on 1.3 % 1.3\% , 1.8 % 1.8\% , and 2.5 % 2.5\% of the frames.
On 77 77 – 81 % 81\% of these frames it brakes less than the reference, and the annotated scene requires the action of DGSP on 61 % 61\% , 62 % 62\% , and 72 % 72\% of them and that of the reference on 33 % 33\% , 32 % 32\% , and 21 % 21\% .
Uniform downscaling departs differently: u512 and u640 brake less and more about equally often, and the annotation sides with the reference on 51 51 – 59 % 59\% of their departures.
The departures of DGSP are thus mostly frames on which the reference brakes without a requirement, which is the source of its higher precision in Tab. 2 .
The detections of the reference itself show where this comes from. Restricting ℱ \mathcal{F} to the crops that DGSP requests on each frame, i.e . , keeping the 31 31 – 42 % 42\% of its detections whose box center lies in a crop and the draft elsewhere, raises its precision from 61.1 % 61.1\% and 70.6 % 70.6\% to 69.4 % 69.4\% and 75.5 % 75.5\% on nuScenes and Argoverse 2, not significantly different from that of DGSP ( 70.7 % 70.7\% and 77.1 % 77.1\% ): there, the gain comes from not acting on what the reference detects outside the regions that the planner marks as relevant. On Argoverse-HD the restricted reference stays at 35.4 % 35.4\% , significantly below DGSP ( 44.3 % 44.3\% ), so that part of the gain there comes from the crop detections and their states. The restricted reference agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 99.4 % 99.4\% , 99.2 % 99.2\% , and 98.5 % 98.5\% of the frames, which bounds what the regions of DGSP lose by themselves.
blocks.zh:
表17列出了输油管从 QQ (F)\pi (\ mathcal{F}) 中脱离的构架。
DGSP的离队次数最少,在1.3% 1.3% 1.3% 1.8% 1.8% 1.5%.和2.5% 2.5%.。
在77 — 81 % 的这些框架上,它比参考文献少了81% 的刹车量,附加说明的场景要求DGSP对其中的61% 61 %,62% 62 %,72% 72 %和33% 33 %,32% 32 % 21 % 采取行动。

因此,DGSP的取出大多是参考制动没有要求的帧,这是其Tab中更精确的出处. 2 (中文(简体) ).
对参考物本身的检测显示它来自何处. F\mathcal{F}限制在DGSP要求每个框架的作物上,即保留其31-42%的探测器,其箱中心位于一株作物和草稿在其他地方,其精度从61.1% 61.1% 和70.6% 70.6% 70.6% 提高到69.4% 69.4% 和75.5% 75.5% 与DGSP(70.7% 70.7% ) 和 77.1% 77.1% 77.1% ============================================================================================================================================================== 在Argoverse-HD中,限制参考值为35.4%35.4%,大大低于DGSP(44.3%44.3%),因此部分收益来自作物探测及其状态。 受限引用同意 \\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 关于99.4% 99.4% , 99.2% 99.2% 99.2% , 和 98.5% 98.5% 的框架, 约束 DGSP 的地区 自己失去的 。

blocks.en:
Results. DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 98.5 % 98.5\% of the frames with 6.7 % 6.7\% of the native pixels and repairs 95.3 % 95.3\% of the disagreements of the draft, both significantly more than u512.
Its F1 is 50.7 50.7 , significantly above that of u512 ( 42.3 42.3 ) and of the reference ( 47.1 47.1 ); it brakes falsely significantly less often than both ( 3.2 3.2 against 5.2 5.2 and 4.1 4.1 episodes per 1,000 1{,}000 frames), and its recall does not differ significantly from theirs.

结果。 DGSP同意\\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F})在98.5%的帧上使用6.7%的土生象素,修复95.3%的草稿分歧,两者都大大超过u512.
其F1为50.7 50.7相,明显高于u512相(42.3 42.3相)和参考相(47.1 47.1相);其刹车的出错次数大大低于两者(3.2 3.2相比 5.2 5.2相比和 4.1 4.1相比 1{,}000相比),其召回量与相差不大.

blocks.en: C.5 Where the remaining disagreement comes from
blocks.zh: 第5条 剩下的分歧来自何处

blocks.en: Table 19 : Where the remaining disagreement comes from (test splits). Oracle interventions, applied cumulatively from top to bottom, that replace one approximation of the implementation by its ideal: the detections of ℱ \mathcal{F} inside the verified crops (locality of the boxes), the states of ℱ \mathcal{F} for these objects (locality of the temporal estimate), and denser or larger probes and more rounds (coverage and termination). The first two are not deployable. Agr.: agreement with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) (%); Diff.: frames that still disagree. † : significantly above DGSP.
blocks.zh: 表19:其余分歧来自何处(测试分出)。 甲骨文干预,从上到下累计应用,用它的理想来取而代之的是执行的一个近似值:在已核实的作物内检测出F\ mathcal{F}(箱的位置),这些物体的F\mathcal{F}状态(时间估计的位置),更密集或更大的探测器和更多发子弹(覆盖和终止). 前两所所出不可发. Agr. : 同意 QQ (F)\pi (\ mathcal{F}) (%); Diff.:仍然有分歧的帧. ^:明显高于DGSP.

blocks.en:
Theorem 1 returns π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) when locality and coverage hold; the implementation approximates both. Table 19 replaces the approximations one at a time by their ideal, cumulatively.
Giving the crops the detections of ℱ \mathcal{F} (locality of the boxes) and then the states of ℱ \mathcal{F} for these objects (locality of the temporal estimate) resolves 50 % 50\% , 52 % 52\% , and 59 % 59\% of the disagreeing frames; a faster probe, a denser grid, and three probe sizes (coverage) resolve most of the rest, and together the interventions raise the agreement from 98.75 % 98.75\% , 98.25 % 98.25\% , and 97.52 % 97.52\% to 99.93 % 99.93\% , 99.79 % 99.79\% , and 99.70 % 99.70\% .
Raising the cap from three to ten rounds changes no frame: no frame stops at the cap.
Without the range refiner, which lies outside the theorem, the picture is the same.
blocks.zh:
定理1 返回 QQ (F )\ pi (\ mathcal{F}) 当地方和覆盖范围保持时; 执行 两者都大致相同 。 表19将近似值一次替换为理想值,累计.
将F\mathcal{F}(盒子的位置)的探测结果和F\mathcal{F}对这些物体(时间估计的位置)的探测结果确定为50%、52%、52%、59%、59 %;更快的探测器、更稠密的网格和三个探测器大小(覆盖)解决了大部分其他问题,干预措施加在一起,使协议从98.75%、98.75%、98.25%、98.25 %、97.52%、97.52%、97.93%、99.93%、99.79%、99.79%、99.70%。
将盖由三发提高至十发,不改变框:没有框在盖上停止.
没有范围精炼器,它位于定理之外,画面是相同的.

blocks.en: Table 20 : The disagreeing frames by the condition of Theorem 1 that fails (test splits). Coverage: an object of ℱ \mathcal{F} that raises the action of the loop has its box center outside every crop; locality: all such objects lie inside crops but are missed or lifted differently; refiner only: the loop agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) without the range refiner. Bottom: rounds per frame.
blocks.zh: 表20: 以定理1的条件表示的出错框架(测试分出). 覆盖: F\ mathcal{F} 提出环行的对象, 在每个收成之外都有它的盒子中心; 位置: 所有这些对象都位于收成之内, 但被忽略或升起不同; 精炼器: 环与 \\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 一致, 没有范围精炼器 。 底部:每帧发弹.

blocks.en:
Table 20 classifies the disagreeing frames directly by the condition that fails; unlike the cumulative interventions of Tab. 19 , it assigns each frame to one condition, so the shares of the two tables differ.
With the refiner, 42 % 42\% , 35 % 35\% , and 40 % 40\% of them violate coverage (an object of ℱ \mathcal{F} that would raise the action lies outside every crop), 31 % 31\% , 34 % 34\% , and 22 % 22\% violate locality, and 11 % 11\% , 22 % 22\% , and 26 % 26\% are due to the refiner alone; on the remaining 16 % 16\% , 9 % 9\% , and 11 % 11\% , DGSP brakes more than π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) without any object of ℱ \mathcal{F} that would raise the action, i.e . , on a detection that ℱ \mathcal{F} lacks or lifts to a lower demand; since conditions (i), (ii), and coverage hold on these frames, this too is a violation of locality, and Sec. 4.2 counts the two together as locality ( 34 34 – 47 % 47\% ).
Most frames need one round; a second round occurs on 4 4 – 12 % 12\% of the frames and a third on fewer than 0.2 % 0.2\% .
About two thirds of the crop detections ( 63 63 – 73 % 73\% ) match a detection of ℱ \mathcal{F} with an IoU of at least 0.9 0.9 .
blocks.zh:
表20将不同意的帧直接按照失败的条件进行分类;与Tab 19. 的累积干涉不同,它将每个帧分配为一个条件,因此两个表格的分量不同.
在炼油厂,42 % 42 % 、35 % 35 % 和40 % 40 % 违反了覆盖范围(一个F\ mathcal{F}的物体,可以提高行动在每一作物之外),31 % 31 %、34 % 34 % 和22 % 违反地方,11 % 11 %、22 % 22 % 和26 % 仅是炼油厂造成的;在剩下的16% 16 %、9% 9 % 和 11 % 11 % 中,DGSP制动超过 + → (F)\ (Mathcal{F}) 没有F\ mathcal{F}的物体,可以提高行动,即发现F\mathcal{F}缺乏或升至较低的需求;由于条件(一),(二),这些框架的覆盖度也违反了地方,而Se.4.2将两者合为地(34 % 47 %)。
大部分帧需要一回合;第二轮发生在4 4 — 12 % 12 — 的帧上,而三分之一的帧不到0.2% 0.2 — 。
大约三分之二的作物探测(63 63 – 73 % 73\%)与F\mathcal{F}的探测结果相匹配,IoU至少为0.9 0.9.

(%;测试分拆). 参考重制在同一帧上被一像素所移动,或被重制为半像素相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 标签 12 中的列 . . . . . DGSP显著高/更低.

blocks.en:
Ceiling of the fidelity measure. The reference itself is not stable under perturbations that carry no information ( Tab. 21 ): recomputed on the frame shifted by one pixel, it agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 99.15 % 99.15\% , 98.79 % 98.79\% , and 98.72 % 98.72\% of the frames, and with a half-pixel resampling phase on 99.0 99.0 – 99.5 % 99.5\% .
The disagreement of DGSP ( 1.3 1.3 – 2.5 % 2.5\% ) is thus about one and a half to two times that of the shifted copy of the reference, and on the frames where π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) changes, the shifted copy agrees on only 90 % 90\% , 90 % 90\% , and 77 % 77\% , against 84 % 84\% , 83 % 83\% , and 68 % 68\% for DGSP.
blocks.zh:
忠诚度量的上限。 参考信息本身并不稳定于没有信息的扰动(Tab. 21):重算了被一像素移动的帧,同意了 99.15% 99.15% , 98.79% 98.79 % 和 98.72% 98.72 % , 以及99.0 99.0 – 99.5% 99.5 % 99.0 上的半像素重排阶段。
因此,DGSP的分歧(1.3 1.3-2.5-2.5-%)是参考文献转录副本的一至二倍左右,在 QQ (F)\pi (\mathcal{F}) 变化的框架中,转录副本只同意90%的90-%、90%的90-%和77-%,而DGSP则同意84-%、83-%和68-%。

blocks.en: C.6 A second detector
blocks.zh: 第6条 第二个探测器

blocks.en: Table 22 : A second detector: YOLO11s as the cheap and the reference detector (%; test splits), with the configuration of DGSP, the lift, and the planner unchanged; ℱ \mathcal{F} is YOLO11s at the verification resolution. Columns as in Tabs. 1 and 2 . Top block: whole-frame inference. † / ∗ : DGSP significantly higher / lower.

Table 22 repeats the main comparison with YOLO11s [ 22 ] as the cheap and the reference detector, keeping the configuration of DGSP, the lift, and the planner.
DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 98.7 % 98.7\% , 98.2 % 98.2\% , and 97.5 % 97.5\% of the frames with 8.3 % 8.3\% , 5.9 % 5.9\% , and 6.8 % 6.8\% of the native pixels, significantly more than u512 on all three datasets, and its F1 ( 69.2 69.2 , 76.5 76.5 , and 46.6 46.6 ) is significantly above that of u512 on all three and above that of the reference on nuScenes (significantly) and Argoverse-HD.
The behavior of DGSP thus carries over to a second detector without retuning.
blocks.zh:
表22重复了与YOLO11s[22]的主要比较,作为廉价和参考检测器,保持了DGSP,升降机,和规划器的配置.
DGSP同意 \\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 关于98.7% , 98.2% 98.2% 98.2 ,以及 97.5% 97.5% 的框架,其中8.3% 8.3 %, 5.9% 5.9 %, 6.8% 6.8% 6.8% 的本地像素, 在所有三个数据集中明显超过u512, 其F1 (69.2 69.2, 76.5 76.5, 46.6) 大大高于u512, 在所有三个和以上关于nuScens (显著) 和 Argoverse-HD 的参考文献中的u512。
DGSP的行为因此延续到第二个探测器而无需再调整.

blocks.en: A native-resolution reference. The result does not depend on the choice of u960 as the reference either. Detected at the native resolution instead of the verification resolution, the regions of DGSP agree with native-resolution inference on 98.4 % 98.4\% , 97.1 % 97.1\% , and 96.8 % 96.8\% of the frames with 14 14 – 16 % 16\% of the native pixels, significantly more often than u960 does ( 97.7 % 97.7\% , 96.0 % 96.0\% , and 93.7 % 93.7\% ); the variant is the row “crops at native scale” of Tab. 33 .
blocks.zh: 本地解析参考. 结果也不取决于选择u960作为参考。 在本地决议而不是核查决议中检测到的DGSP地区同意本地决议的推论,即98.4% 98.4% ,97.1% 97.1% ,96.8% ,其中14.4% ,16% 16.6% ,比u960多得多(97.7% ,96.0% 和93.7% 93.7% );变体是Tab.33的一行 " 原生象素 " 。

blocks.en: C.7 A detector fine-tuned on driving data
blocks.zh: 第7条 对驱动数据进行微调的探测器

blocks.en: Table 23 : A detector fine-tuned on driving data (%; test splits): YOLOv8s fine-tuned on the training images of nuScenes and Argoverse 2 as the cheap and the reference detector, with the looming estimate and the range refiner retrained on its crops; the configuration of DGSP, the confidence threshold, and the planner are unchanged. px: detector-input pixels (% of native); Agr., Rep.: as in Tab. 1 ; P, R, F1: braking episodes as in Tab. 2 ; –: 100 100 by definition. Top block: whole-frame inference. † / ∗ : DGSP significantly higher / lower.
blocks.zh: 表23:对驱动数据进行微调的探测器(%);测试分数: YOLOv8s微调了nuScenes和Argoverse 2作为廉价和参考探测器的训练图像,其作物上即将到来的估计和测距精炼器重新被训练;DGSP的配置,置信阈值,以及规划者不变. px: 探测器- 输入像素 (% introduct; Agr., Rep: 如 Tab. 1; P, R, F1: 如 Tab. 2; –: 定义上100起. 上方块:全帧推论. ____________________________________________________________________________________________________ DGSP显著高/更低.

blocks.en:
The detector of the main paper is pretrained on COCO only. Table 23 repeats the main comparison with YOLOv8s fine-tuned on the front-camera images of the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 training sets, excluding every development and test scene or log ( 15 15 epochs at 640 640 pixels, checkpoint selected on held-out training scenes), as the cheap and the reference detector; the looming estimate and the range refiner are retrained on its crops, and the configuration of DGSP, the confidence threshold ( 0.25 0.25 ), and the planner are unchanged.
DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 97.8 % 97.8\% , 95.3 % 95.3\% , and 96.7 % 96.7\% of the frames, significantly more often than u512 on all three datasets and, on Argoverse 2, than every whole-frame resolution.
Its F1 is the highest of all pipelines on nuScenes (with DGSP-fast) and on Argoverse-HD, and the second highest on Argoverse 2, below native-resolution inference (not significantly); it is significantly above those of u512 and the reference on nuScenes and Argoverse 2.
It uses 2.8 2.8 – 3.8 × 3.8\times fewer pixels than the reference.
blocks.zh:
主纸的探测器只在COCO上预先训练. 表23重复了与YOLOv8s在前相机上微调的nuScenes和Argoverse 2训练集的主要对比,不包括每一个开发和测试场景或日志(15个15个世纪,640像素,停放训练场所选择的检查站),作为廉价和参考探测器;即将到来的估计和测距精炼器对其农作物进行再训练,DGSP的配置,置信阈值(0.250.25),规划者不变.
DGSP同意 \\\\ (F)\ (\ mathcal{F}) 的 97.8% 97.8\,95.3% 95.3\,96.7% 的 帧, 在所有三个数据集中比 u512 更频繁, 在 Argoverse 2 上比每个全帧分辨率都要多 。
它的F1是nuScenes上(与DGSP-fast)和Argoverse-HD上的所有管线中最高的,而Argoverse上第二高,低于土生分辨率推论(非显著);它明显地高于u512,并参考了nuScenes和Argoverse 2.
它使用 2.8 2.8 – 3.8 × 3.8\times 比引用的像素要少.

blocks.en: C.8 A geometric lift in every pipeline
blocks.zh: C.8 联合国 每条管道都有几何升降机

blocks.en:
The learned parts of the lift, the looming estimate and the range refiner, are shared by every pipeline of the main paper, including the reference.
With both removed from every pipeline, ranges come from the ground plane and class heights and the time to collision from the growth of the box, and π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) is recomputed with this lift; the crops, and hence the pixels, stay close to those of Tab. 1 (DGSP: 8.2 % 8.2\% , 5.8 % 5.8\% , and 6.9 % 6.9\% ).
Fidelity carries over: DGSP agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 96.7 % 96.7\% , 91.2 % 91.2\% , and 88.0 % 88.0\% of the frames, 3.3 3.3 , 7.3 7.3 , and 10.7 10.7 points more than u512 (significantly on all three datasets).
The fidelity of DGSP thus does not depend on the learned parts of the lift.
blocks.zh:
主纸的每条管线,包括参考书,都分享升力、下行估计和测距精炼器的学习部分。
每条管线都除去后,从地面平面和等级高度以及从箱体生长到相撞的时间不等,而 (F)\pi(\mathcal{F})与这种起重机重合;作物,因此像素与Tab. 1相接相近(DGSP:8.2% 8.2\%; 5.8% 5.8\%; 6.9% 6.9\%)。
Fidelity 继续:DGSP同意 \\\ (F )\ (\ mathcal{F}) 96.7% 96.7% ,91.2% 91.2% ,88.0% 88.0% 的框架,3.33.3 , 7.3 7.3 和 10.7 10.7 比u512多点(在所有三个数据集中都显著).
因此,DGSP的忠诚度并不取决于升降机的学习部分.

blocks.en: C.9 Where the pixels go
blocks.zh: C.9 联合国 在像素去的地方

blocks.en: Table 24 : Where the pixels of DGSP go (test splits). Frames on which the draft alone decides, the mean and median detector-input pixels per frame, and their mean by source; the sources sum to the mean.
blocks.zh: 表24:DGSP的像素到哪里去(测试分出). 仅由草案决定的框架,每个框架的平均和中位探测器-输入像素,以及它们按源的平均值;源与平均值相加。

blocks.en:
Table 24 breaks down the cost of DGSP.
On 35 % 35\% , 29 % 29\% , and 24 % 24\% of the frames, the draft alone decides: the field and the support request nothing.
The draft accounts for 44 44 – 51 % 51\% of the pixels, the field footprint for 19 19 – 23 % 23\% , and the truncation guard for 11 11 – 16 % 16\% ; the support crops, the crops of objects verified in the previous frame, and the previous-frame re-detections take the rest.
The median frame costs 7.4 % 7.4\% , 4.7 % 4.7\% , and 5.3 % 5.3\% of the native pixels.

Table 25 : FLOPs per frame (GFLOPs, mean over the test frames). Det.: the detector, proportional to the detector-input pixels; Lift: the looming estimate and the range refiner on the objects that each pipeline passes through them, once per round for the loops; Total: their sum. Not counted: the planner queries of the field and the support (closed form here) and the selection networks of AdaScale and the routers. Top block: whole-frame inference.
blocks.zh: 表25:每个框架的FLOP(GFLOP,测试框架的平均值). Det.: 探测器,与探测器-输入像素成正比; 抬起:每道管所经过的物体上即将到来的估计和测距精炼器,每回合一次为环; 总:其和. 未计数 : 规划者对字段的查询和支持( 在此关闭表单) 以及 Ada Scale 和路由器的选择网络 。 上方块:全帧推论.

blocks.en:
FLOPs. YOLOv8s performs 70.3 70.3 kFLOPs per input pixel at every input size of the experiments ( 36 36 canvases from 32 × 32 32\times 32 to 2048 × 1568 2048\times 1568 , counted with thop), so the detector FLOPs of a frame are proportional to its detector-input pixels.
All FLOPs follow the convention of this counter for the detector, two FLOPs per multiply-accumulate.
The looming estimate and the refiner are standard ResNet-18 networks applied to 64 × 64 64\times 64 crops that are upsampled to 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixels ( 1.19 1.19 GFLOPs per crop), so the lift adds 3.57 3.57 GFLOPs per object for the looming estimate (three crops) and 1.19 1.19 GFLOPs per object for the refiner. Table 25 counts them for the objects that each pipeline passes through them: whole-frame pipelines pass every detection with a same-scale chain over three frames through the looming estimate, DGSP only its verified objects.
The detector FLOPs of DGSP are 22 % 22\% , 25 % 25\% , and 27 % 27\% of those of the reference, the ratios of the pixels.
In total, DGSP uses 11.4 11.4 , 21.3 21.3 , and 25.1 25.1 GFLOPs per frame on average, 23 % 23\% , 28 % 28\% , and 36 % 36\% of the reference, and less than u512 ( 17.8 17.8 , 33.1 33.1 , and 32.6 32.6 ) on every dataset.

blocks.en: Table 26 : Ablation: pixels, agreement, precision, and recall (%; test splits; complements the repair rate and F1 of Tab. 4 ). † / ∗ : the full procedure is significantly higher / lower.
