blocks.en:
Table 26 adds the pixels, the agreement, and the precision and recall behind Tab. 4 .
The field and the support act on opposite errors.
Without the field, the recall falls by 14 14 , 6 6 , and 7 7 points (all significant) at 1.8 1.8 – 2.7 2.7 points fewer pixels: the support alone cannot reach what the draft does not show.
Without the support, the recall is about that of the draft and the precision falls to 11 11 – 37 % 37\% , since the spurious detections of the draft are never verified.
Removal pivots in place of the support keep the recall and lose precision, most on Argoverse-HD ( 23.6 % 23.6\% against 44.3 % 44.3\% ), consistent with construction (c) of Sec. A.6 : draft detections that each justify the action leave no pivot to verify.
The truncation guard costs 0.8 0.8 – 1.0 1.0 points of pixels and buys 7 7 – 11 11 points of precision, and the range refiner buys 5 5 – 13 13 points of precision without changing the pixels.

替换支持的去除小块保持回放并失去精确度,大部分在Argoverse-HD上(23.6% 23.6\%,44.3% 44.3\%),与Sec的构造(c)一致。 A.6: 检测草稿,每一份都证明行动是合理的,没有主线进行验证。

blocks.en: Table 31 : The field depends on the action and the ego speed (test splits). At hard-brake , no stronger action exists, so the field is empty and only the support is verified.

blocks.en:
The field is a function of the current action and of the ego speed ( Tab. 31 ), which is why it needs few pixels.
At keep , it is requested on 60 60 – 67 % 67\% of the frames.
At decelerate , it contains only the states that would raise the action to hard-brake , a shorter corridor, and is requested on 62 62 – 73 % 73\% of the frames.
At hard-brake , no stronger action exists, the field is empty, and only the support is verified.
When the ego speed is scaled, the farthest sensitive range of the field grows from about 40 40 m to 53 53 – 61 61 m, and the pixels of DGSP grow from 5.9 5.9 – 8.4 % 8.4\% to 6.6 6.6 – 9.8 % 9.8\% of the native frame.

Table 32 keeps the crops of DGSP on every frame, with their sizes and hence about their pixels, and moves them to random positions.
The repair rate falls from 87 87 – 92 % 92\% to 20 20 – 29 % 29\% , the recovery of the objects that the draft misses from 41.5 41.5 – 75.5 % 75.5\% to 8 8 – 18 % 18\% , and the F1 to the level of the draft, on all three datasets and for every seed: the gain of DGSP comes from where the field and the support put the pixels, not from their number.
Crops around the annotated decision-relevant objects, a region rule that knows the answer, recover about as many missed objects as DGSP with fewer pixels, but agree with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on only 87.5 87.5 – 94.7 % 94.7\% of the frames and have an F1 below the draft’s: they never verify the spurious or mislocalized draft detections on which a braking action rests, which is the role of the support.

blocks.en:
Table 33 compares the regions of DGSP with two other ways to spend crops.
Uncertainty crops, which verify the least confident draft detections with the crop pixels of DGSP, are significantly less faithful and have a significantly lower F1 on all three datasets, below u512.
Detecting the regions of DGSP at the native resolution instead of the verification resolution costs 1.6 1.6 – 2.5 × 2.5\times the pixels and lowers the agreement and the repair rate significantly, since the crops then differ from the reference in scale and not only in context; its F1 is close to that of DGSP.
Measured against native-resolution inference instead, the same variant agrees with π ⁡ ( native ) \pi(\text{native}) on 98.4 % 98.4\% , 97.1 % 97.1\% , and 96.8 % 96.8\% of the frames with 14 14 – 16 % 16\% of the native pixels, significantly more often than u960 ( 97.7 % 97.7\% , 96.0 % 96.0\% , and 93.7 % 93.7\% ): the result does not depend on the choice of u960 as the reference.

在原生分辨率下检测DGSP的区域,而不是核查分辨率,费用为1.61.6 — — 2.5×2.5\时,像素并显著地降低协议和维修率,因为作物在规模上和背景上都不同;其F1接近DGSP。

blocks.en: D.7 Parameters of the field
blocks.zh: D.7 领域参数

blocks.en: Table 34 : Sensitivity to the parameters of the field (test splits). px: detector-input pixels relative to the reported configuration; Agr.: agreement with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) (%); F1 of the braking episodes (%); Diff.: frames on which the action differs from that of the reported configuration. † / ∗ : the reported configuration significantly higher / lower.
blocks.zh: 表34:对字段参数的敏感性(测试分数). px: 相对于所报配置的检测器- 输入像素; Agr: 与 QQ (F)\pi (\ mathcal{F} (%) 达成协议; 制动事件中的 F 1 (%); Diff. : 动作与所报配置不同的框架 。 QQ / : 所报配置明显高/ 更低 。

blocks.en:
Table 34 varies the probe and the grid of the field around the reported configuration.
The action is insensitive to the spacing of the grid: halving the lateral spacing or halving or doubling the range spacing changes the action on at most four frames of a dataset, and a static probe gives exactly the actions and pixels of the probe closing at 3 3 m/s: for the braking controller, this closing speed reaches the threshold only nearer than the first range of the grid ( 12.5 12.5 m), which the ego speed already covers.
A faster or larger probe enlarges the footprint: a probe closing at 10 10 m/s or a truck-sized probe raises the agreement by 0.1 0.1 – 0.3 0.3 points at 1.15 1.15 – 1.30 × 1.30\times the pixels, without a significant change of the F1, and a pedestrian-sized probe lowers both. Doubling the lateral spacing saves 11 11 – 15 % 15\% of the pixels and changes 29 29 – 72 72 actions without a significant change of either measure.
The probe therefore sets an operating point on the trade-off between pixels and fidelity, and the grid spacing is not critical.
blocks.zh:
表34 围绕所报配置的探测器和球场网格不同.
动作对网格间距不敏感:将平相间距减半或将范围间距减半或翻倍,最多在数据集的4个框架上改变动作,静态探测器给出精确的探测器动作和像素以3个3米/秒收尾: 对于制动控制器来说,这种收尾速度只比自负速度已经覆盖的网格第一个范围(12.5 12.5米)更接近阈值.
更快或更大的探测器能扩大足迹:探测器以10-10米/秒或卡车大小的探测器将协议提升了0.1–0.3分,1.15–1.30相距像素,F1没有显著变化;行人大小的探测器将两者降低. 双倍间距节省了11 11 — 15% — 15 — — 像素, 并改变了29 — 29 — 72个动作,但两者均没有重大变化。
因此,探测器在像素和忠诚之间的取舍上设定了一个操作点,而网格间距并不关键.

blocks.en:
Planners. The curved-path braking controller is the controller of Sec. B.1 with the ego corridor bent along the path of constant curvature given by the ego yaw rate.
The time-to-collision warning is a second max-composable planner: its per-object demand is the inverse time-to-collision of an object in the ego corridor, with thresholds for a warning and for braking, and a static probe at range r r has the time-to-collision r / v r/v .
Each planner defines its own required action, episodes, field, and support through Corollary 1 , and the loop, the crops, the guard, and the lift are unchanged. The field of the curved-path controller is used without the margin, and the loop of the warning uses the pinhole footprint and no crops of objects verified in the previous frame.
The bottleneck selector on NAVSIM is specified in Sec. A.7 .
blocks.zh:
计生. 曲线-路径制动控制器是 Sec. B. 1 的控制器,其自负走廊会沿着自负率给出的恒定曲率路径弯曲.
时间到碰撞警告是第二个最大可构成的规划器:其每个对象的需求是自负走廊上物体的反相时间到碰撞,有警告和制动的阈值,在r 范围内的静态探测器有时间到碰撞 r / v r/v.
每个计划员通过Corlollary 1定义了自己的所需动作,事件,场地,以及支持,而循环,收成,警卫,升降都没有变化. 曲线-路径控制器的球场在没有比值的情况下被使用,而警告的回路则使用针孔足迹,没有在上个帧被验证的物体的收成.
NAVSIM上的瓶颈选择器在Sec.A.7.中指定.

blocks.en:
Results. With the regions of the planner in use, DGSP has the highest precision in five of the six columns and an F1 that does not differ significantly from that of whole-frame inference at the reference resolution, with 3.6 3.6 – 5.1 × 5.1\times fewer pixels. Table 36 adds the fidelity to the reference under each planner.
Under the curved-path controller, DGSP with its own regions agrees with π ⁡ ( ℱ ) \pi(\mathcal{F}) on 97.1 97.1 – 98.5 % 98.5\% of the frames, significantly more often than u512 and than DGSP with the braking regions on every dataset, with fewer pixels than both.
Under the warning, it agrees significantly more often than with the braking regions on nuScenes and Argoverse 2.
The planner-specific settings above were not selected on any data; they follow from how each loop reuses the braking configuration.
blocks.zh:
结果。 随着规划者所在区域被使用,DGSP在6个列中的5个列的精度最高,而一个F1在参考解析度上与全帧推论没有显著区别,3.6 3.6 – 5.1 × 5.1\的像素较少. 表36在每个规划人员项下的参考文献中增加了忠诚度。
在曲线路径控制器下,拥有自有区域的DGSP在97.197.1–98.5%的帧上同意了QQ (F)\pi (\mathcal{F}),比u512和DGSP在每个数据集上的制动区域要多得多,像素比两者都少.
在警告下,比起在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上与制动区域相比,它更经常同意。
上面的规划器特定设置没有在任何数据上被选中;它们遵循的是每个循环如何再利用制动配置.

blocks.en: Appendix E Controlled closed loop
blocks.zh: 附录E 受控闭环

blocks.en:
This section specifies the controlled closed loop of Sec. 4.5 and reports all of its metrics.
To isolate the effect of where the detector runs on longitudinal control, the closed loop of Sec. 4.5 runs in CARLA 0.9.15 [ 8 ] on the 155 155 Bench2Drive [ 21 ] evaluation routes whose scenarios require braking for vehicles, pedestrians, or bicycles and need no lateral maneuver around an actor, with three traffic seeds per route.
blocks.zh:
本节具体说明第4.5条的控制闭环,并报告其所有指标。
为了隔离探测器运行在纵向控制上的影响,4.5塞克的闭环以CARLA 0.9.15 [8]在155 Bench2Drive [21]评价路线上运行,其情景需要为车辆、行人或自行车制动并不需要在演员周围进行横向操作,每条路线有3个交通种子.

blocks.en:
Loop. A route follower controls the steering and the target speed without seeing any actor, and the braking controller of Sec. B.1 acts on the scene that each perception pipeline estimates, with a hold at standstill.
All pipelines use the same YOLOv8s and the geometric lift with a time-to-collision from the growth of the box over 0.5 0.5 s; the looming estimate and the range refiner, which were trained on real images, are not used in simulation. The action of a frame is applied in the same simulation step.
blocks.zh:
循环。 一个路由跟踪器在没有看到任何演员的情况下控制了方向盘和目标速度,而Sec. B.1的制动控制器在现场表现为每个感官管线估计,被搁置.
所有输油管均使用同一种YOLOv8和从箱体生长到0.5 s的相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 一个帧的动作被应用在同一模拟步骤中.

blocks.en:
Metrics. Required braking episodes are defined on the privileged states of the simulator as in Sec. B.3 ; an episode is missed if the pipeline does not brake during it, and a hard-braking onset is unnecessary if these states do not require hard-brake .
A collision is preventable unless it is a side or rear impact or the braking demand on the privileged states arises less than v / 6 + 0.4 v/6+0.4 s before the contact, where v v is the ego speed; most collisions on these routes are not preventable by longitudinal control.
Differences are tested with a paired bootstrap over routes, with the seeds averaged per route.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 在模拟器的特权状态下定义了必要的制动事件,如Sec.B.3;如果管道在运行过程中不刹车,则会错过一集;如果这些状态不需要硬刹车,则不必要出现硬刹起。
碰撞是可预防的,除非是侧向或后向撞击,或者在接触前对特权国提出的刹车要求少于v 6 + 0.4 v/6+0.4 s,因为v是自负速度;这些路线上的大多数碰撞不能通过纵向控制来预防.
不同之处在路线上用一对靴子测试,每条路线平均有种子.

blocks.en:
Results. Tab. 6 and Tab. 37 report the rollouts of the 155 155 routes with three seeds each.
DGSP has the fewest unnecessary hard-braking onsets, significantly fewer than every perception pipeline, and the fewest missed required episodes, significantly fewer than u320 and u512.
Preventable collisions are rare ( 0.4 0.4 – 1.7 % 1.7\% of the rollouts): DGSP has 2 2 in 465 465 rollouts, against 7 7 for the draft, 8 8 for u512, 5 5 for the reference, and 6 6 for native-resolution inference.
The experiment characterizes braking behavior, not driving safety.
blocks.zh:
结果:表6和表37报告155道155道各有3个种子。
DGSP的不必要硬起发次数最少,大大少于每个感官管道,被错过次数最少,大大少于u320和u512.
可预防的相撞是罕见的(推出时的0.4 – 1.7% ): DGSP在465 465的推出中有2个,其中7个为草稿,8个为u512,5个为参考,6个为本土解析推论.
实验定性为制动行为,而非驾驶安全.

blocks.en: The frames of Fig. 4 and of Figs. 7 , 8 and 6 are selected by a fixed rule on the stored test results, with categories defined by the actions: • unnecessary braking removed : the required action is keep , the draft brakes, and DGSP and the reference keep; • range corrected : the draft detects a decision-relevant object, the draft and DGSP without the refiner take an action other than the required one, and DGSP takes it; • unseen object recovered : a decision-relevant object is missed by the draft and by the support-only ablation and found by the reference and by DGSP, which takes the required action; For each category and dataset, the first qualifying frame in time order is shown; none is chosen by inspection. Fig. 4 (b) shows the first category on nuScenes, and Fig. 7 shows the other two on nuScenes and Figs. 8 and 6 all three on Argoverse 2.
blocks.zh: 图四和图四的相框. 7,8和6按照关于所存储测试结果的固定规则进行选择,分类由动作定义: • 移除不必要的制动:所需动作是保存,制动草稿,以及DGSP和参考保存; • 范围被更正:草案检测到一个与决定相关的对象,草案和DGSP没有精炼者采取所要求的行动,而DGSP采取; • 无形对象被回收:一个与决定相关的对象被草案和仅支持的减量所错过,并且被参考和DGSP发现,它采取了必要的行动; 对于每个类别和数据集,按时间顺序显示第一个合格框架; 没有通过检查选择任何对象. 图4(b)在nuScenes上显示第一类,而图7则在nuScenes和Fgs上显示另外两个. 8和6 所有三个在Argoverse 2。

blocks.en: unnecessary braking removed : the required action is keep , the draft brakes, and DGSP and the reference keep;
blocks.zh: 已删除不必要的制动:所需操作是保留、制动和DGSP及参考保存;

blocks.en: range corrected : the draft detects a decision-relevant object, the draft and DGSP without the refiner take an action other than the required one, and DGSP takes it;
blocks.zh: 范围更正:草案检测到一个与决定相关的对象,草案和没有提炼者的DGSP采取要求以外的行动,DGSP采取;

blocks.en: unseen object recovered : a decision-relevant object is missed by the draft and by the support-only ablation and found by the reference and by DGSP, which takes the required action;
blocks.zh: 不可见对象回收: 草案和只支持的终止省略了与决定相关的对象, 参考文献和DGSP找到了它,它采取了必要的行动;

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 (a) is meant to show the field alone reaching an object, which the third category does not ensure: there, the object can also lie in the crop of an object verified in the previous frame or of another detection’s support.
Its frame therefore meets a stricter rule, applied to every nuScenes and Argoverse 2 test frame on which the draft keeps the speed while braking is required and DGSP takes the required action: a decision-relevant object that no draft box overlaps lies in the field footprint of the first round, in no crop of an object verified in the previous frame and in no first-round support crop, was not verified in the previous frame, and is found by DGSP; any other crop that contains it is built around it after it is found.
Eleven objects qualify, six on nuScenes, all at night, and five on Argoverse 2, all in daylight; no frame qualifies if, in addition, no later crop may contain the object.
Among the four daylight frames with the object beyond 25 25 m, Fig. 4 (a) shows the only one in which DGSP finds every decision-relevant object that the draft misses and the support alone would keep the speed (Argoverse 2, a pedestrian crossing 37 37 m ahead).
blocks.zh:
图4(a)的用意是,仅显示到达物体的字段,第三类不能保证:在那里,物体也可以位于在前一个框架或另一个探测器支持的物体的收成上.
因此其框架符合更严格的规则,适用于草案在需要制动时保持速度的每个nuScenes和Argoverse 2测试框架,并且DGSP会采取必要的行动:一个与决定相关的对象,即草案框没有重叠于第一轮的场地脚印上,没有被上一轮框架核实的物体的收成,没有被上一轮框架核实,也没有被DGSP发现;其他含有它的收成是在发现后围绕它所建.
11个物体符合条件,其中6个在nuScenes上,全部在夜间,5个在Argoverse 2上,全部在白天;如果除此之外,以后的收割可能不包含该物体,则没有框架符合条件。
在物体超过25米的4个日光相框中,图4(a)显示了DGSP唯一发现的每个与决定相关的物体,如果草案和仅靠支持就可以保持速度(Argoverse 2,行人横跨37米前方).

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 is meant to show the support and the field on one daylight frame.
On daylight nuScenes test frames, no first round requests both a support crop and a field footprint that recovers a missed object.
The frame therefore meets the following rule: in daylight, the draft takes decelerate , the first round verifies only the support crop and lowers the action to keep , the second round verifies the field of keep , the two crops overlap with an IoU below 0.3 0.3 and each covers at least 3 % 3\% of the image, and DGSP returns the required keep within two rounds.
Twelve nuScenes test frames qualify; Fig. 2 shows one of them chosen for legibility (a single vehicle ahead and two clearly separated crops), and the top view is cropped to the near range, where the field of keep lies at this ego speed.
blocks.zh:
发相. 2的用意是在一个日光相框上显示支持和场面.
在日光nuScens测试框上,没有第一轮既要求支持作物,又要求田地脚印能取回被丢失的物体.
因此相框符合以下规则: 在日出时, 草稿会减速 , 第一轮只验证支持作物并降低保存动作 , 第二轮验证保存地 , 两种作物与低于0. 0. 3 的 IOU相重叠, 每一种覆盖图像的至少3% 3 + , DGSP在两轮内返回所需的保存.
12个nuScenes测试帧符合条件; 图2显示其中选取的1个用于可辨别性(前方单车和2个明显分离的收成),而顶部视图被收成到相近的地平线上,所保持的地平线就在这个自负速度上.
